The Ruler (Jūn) should be good at opening and guiding those below him,
Issue clear orders and proclamations,
instructing the people to stay in their respective places and submit memorials,
reporting all that they have heard concerning good and evil.
By proceeding thus,
one may also simply send them for convenience,
or send them by merchant carts,
or clearly identify one's own name and arrive in person;
by establishing the law in this manner,
then all the good and evil in the world will be fully revealed.
The ruler guides the Qi of Heaven to flow downward,
the ministers guide the Qi of Earth to flow upward,
and the people guide the Qi of Central Harmony to flow upward.
The Zhēnrén transmits the book,
delivering it to a ruler of virtue.
If you carefully examine and listen to my written words,
immediate peace and immediate joy will be established,
calamities and anomalies will be eliminated,
without missing a single grain.
My book is reverently received from the laws of Heaven;
it does not merely present empty, false words.
Heaven has executed my son;
do you also know that this punishment is heavy?"
"Yes, yes."
"If you wish to obtain my book,
believe in it and immediately manage affairs with its efficacy,
establishing a resonance with Heaven and Earth like an echo;
this is the proof of my writing.
Using this as a great and clear verification,
one may harbor no doubts.
The way of governing a state,
for those who delight in obtaining Heaven's heart and finding peace,
is simply to perform this verification,
to resonate like an echo with Heaven;
this is the clear bond of Heaven conversing with man.
I only see that the Zhēnrén always delights in assisting a ruler of virtue,
wishing to repay Heaven's great merit;
therefore, I speak of it in detail.
I know the error lies here:
the book is blocked and cannot be received.
The ruler should create clear teachings and good orders,
stating that from now on,
officials and commoners should each stay in their respective places,
diligently submitting memorials
to report all good and evil,
to clarify the governance of the Dìwáng,
to connect with the Qi of Heaven.
They must not be hindered from doing so;
those who hinder them shall be punished for three years.
If an individual submits a memorial with complete sincerity,
without deceitful writing,
it is said they shall be summoned and given office.
As for how they shall be given office,
each shall be asked about their talents and strengths,
and be appointed to a post according to the reach of their physical and mental strength.
Why must they be appointed according to what their strength can reach?
In Heaven's dealing with man,
each is treated according to their ability;
if they are not treated according to their talent,
it is called willfully wronging people,
which again creates knotted Qi and increases disasters.
The reason for this is that
what is beyond a person's reach,
even from birth to death,
they still cannot do.
What people today delight in
is the extreme joy of obtaining fine things like gold and jade.
Suppose a wise ruler now issues a teaching,
saying that if someone can, with a wave of the hand, obtain all the gold, silver, and rare treasures of the state officials,
it will not be considered your fault,
but will all be given to you;
that person would be extremely happy to get it,
but if their strength cannot reach the object,
even if their two hands are worn out,
they still cannot obtain it.
Now, as the parents and ruler of the people,
if you are to appoint ministers and subjects to posts,
but not according to their strengths,
it is just like killing them;
they still cannot manage their official duties,
but merely throw their offices into chaos in vain,
only causing grief and suffering to the people.
When offices are in chaos
and people and ministers are in grief,
then they again look up and cry out to Heaven,
stating their own grievances;
this moves Heaven above
and again increases disasters and strange occurrences.
Therefore, the Shèngxián of old wished to gain Heaven's heart;
they were extremely cautious in making appointments,
all of which gained the people's hearts,
thus they were able to match Heaven's heart.
What does matching Heaven's heart mean?
Carrying it out brings a response from the people,
officials daily become better, more trustworthy, and loyal;
this is the verification.
Then promote them in due time;
these are the people who help the state gain Heaven's heart.
Some only have joy,
but once they greedily seek fame and obtain office,
their actions have no verification,
and they do not match Heaven's heart and receive no response.
For the Dìwáng governs by receiving Heaven's heart;
one must certainly match Heaven's heart,
for not matching Heaven's heart is a transgression.
Therefore, if their governance has no good response,
they should withdraw and be made to reflect on their errors;
in this way, Heaven is already pleased,
and no one in the world will fail to be fully loyal and trustworthy,
doing their utmost with their abilities.
When those in obscure and distant places hear of this,
none will hide their abilities.
Those who submit urgent memorials,
as human life is of utmost importance,
must not wait even for a moment.
Otherwise, people will again cry out and wail about grievances,
this would again knot and increase strange transformations;
one should quickly resolve and respond to them.
Matters that can be endured should wait for autumn and winter.
Why must they wait for autumn and winter?
It is because in autumn, all things are completed,
and in winter, all things are stored away;
the Qi of Heaven is settled.
Things ripen in the mid-autumn eighth month,
and their fruits and seeds can be distinguished;
therefore, one should follow the laws of Heaven and Earth,
and begin by distinguishing and examining them in the eighth month.
The ninth month
is the culmination of the Qi of Heaven;
by the ninth month, all things are about to die.
Therefore, in the ninth month, one should exhaustively read and examine them,
observing the amount of good and evil.
Ten
is the end of numbers;
therefore, things reach the tenth month and return to the beginning.
The Heavenly Standard takes the eighth month as the tenth,
thus things are fully completed.
The Earthly Standard takes the ninth month as the tenth,
thus things are fully aged.
The Human Standard takes the Hài branch as the tenth month,
thus things are fully dead.
When the Three Standards are finished,
things shall be born again.
Therefore, Qián is in the northwest;
all things begin their seeds in Hài.
The law of Heaven uses the eighth month to distinguish them,
the ninth month to finalize them,
and the tenth month to verify the seeds;
thus the Three Successions of Heaven, Earth, and Man all come to an end,
being verified at Hài.
Therefore, in the tenth month, verify the facts
and send them back down.
The reason for this is
that these three months—the eighth, ninth, and tenth—
are when the standards of Heaven, Earth, and Man are all completed
and should return to the beginning again.
If they are not verified and examined
and their meaning is not obtained,
then Heaven and Earth will not be pleased,
their calamities will not be removed,
and they will again harm the coming year.
Therefore, distinguish and examine them in the eighth month,
finalize them in the ninth month,
verify the facts in the tenth month,
and send them back down.
Cause all officials and people to further reflect on their faults,
so that they dare not do them again.
In the coming year, officials and people will be more cautious,
and all things will be good.
If they are not sent back to reflect on their errors, they will remain stubborn;
if the people and ministers below lose the government's orders,
and do not know they have faults,
their hearts will not change.
The Way of Heaven will remain stagnant,
and evil will not change;
therefore, one must send them back.
If the Zhēnrén wishes to know the efficacy,
regarding what is sent back this year,
have one copy of the document placed by yourself,
and also teach the officials and people to record one copy themselves and keep it,
to observe the amount of good and evil;
this is called the Heavenly Bond.
When sending back in the coming year,
again keep one copy,
to observe the amount of good and evil;
in the following year, send back again,
keep one copy,
and observe the amount of good and evil.
Compare the records below with those kept above;
they should naturally correspond,
and this is called the Heavenly Omen and the Matching Tally.
Causing the officials and people to change their hearts and do good,
obtaining Heaven's intent,
what is submitted should contain much good;
if there is a great change, there should be great goodness.
If they remain stubborn,
with no transformation or change,
what is submitted will remain stagnant;
if they do not stop doing evil,
what is submitted will become increasingly evil,
and the officials and people will greatly deceive and anger Heaven.
Regarding the reports of great evils that have intensified and worsened,
these are reflected in Heaven's mirror, which brightly illuminates the heart.
It does not miss even the smallest fraction
in clarifying the conduct and governance of officials and the people.
Heaven and Earth are like a shadow and an echo;
they follow a person and cannot be escaped.
The Zhēnrén is fortunate to have good intentions;
strive to complete them and be cautious.
Although you have come to ask about this,
it may seem as though it is nothing or of no benefit.
Heaven observes silently within;
your mouth may speak,
but how can speech clarify things?
When a person speaks of matters,
if the words are detailed and good,
people will respond with goodness,
and the echo will also respond with goodness.
If the words are ominous, evil, and inauspicious,
people will also respond with evil,
and the echo will also respond with evil.
All things that respond to and harmonize with one another
are caused by Heaven.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"Heaven is high, distant, and majestic;
how could it personally descend to speak with people about every matter?
Therefore, its laws all involve natural response and harmony.
Is your heart open now?"
"Yes, yes.
I have understood,
and I wish to ask the Tiānshī for one more word."
"Proceed and speak of it."
"In middle antiquity, the Huáng had no written script
and the three did not communicate through it;
how were they able to bring peace?"
"Excellent,
your question!
The celestial cycles caused the people of that time to be upright and simple;
those people all embraced the Dào,
and their faith was single-minded.
Although they communicated only through oral rumors,
everyone desired to reach the utmost sincerity and faith
and thought to match the heart of Heaven;
thus, there was not a single person who deceived another.
Therefore, the three—ruler, official, and people—
joined their forces and shared one mind in communication;
thus, they were able to govern one another.
If they had not shared one mind as one family,
there would have been chaos.
Nowadays, there is Chéngfù,
and written documents are numerous.
They use writing to deceive one another
and still value superficiality.
The worthy and the Rú are both confused,
and together they have lost the heart of Heaven.
Since Heaven has produced writing,
one cannot return to oral rumors.
One must simply verify the truth to obtain reality;
when the three communicate, the Qì of Heaven will be balanced.
Heaven's laws
may be millions or tens of thousands;
the times are always different,
governances are each distinct,
and methods are each different.
Now the Qì of Tàipíng is about to arrive;
one should rectify the documents based on the original correct characters;
then one will attain the intent of Heaven's heart.
You are unable to distinguish that
since Heaven and Earth established affairs,
governance has had millions of facets.
In practicing these affairs,
those that receive a response from Heaven are correct;
those that do not receive a response from Heaven
are wrong.
This is the great and clear verification and proof of the Tiānquàn.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
and do not ask again.
It is not that I cannot record everything for you
since the establishment of Heaven and Earth
and explain every character in the world,
but adding more writing is difficult to record;
it cannot be utilized by talent
and is of no benefit to the King's governance.
Therefore, I only point out and instruct on the essential Dào.
If governance is not orderly,
it originates fundamentally from Tiānwén;
this is a great illness and malady of Heaven and Earth,
which was loathed by the sages and worthies of old.
Therefore, the Dào appears for a virtuous ruler;
he does not dare to create more writing
but makes everyone return to and maintain reality.
Seek the root
and preserve the Yuán;
then the Dào of Heaven can be ordered
and the state will naturally be at peace.
Although the Zhēnrén likes to ask,
do not let him add more writing.
Go and contemplate this."
"Yes, yes."

To the right: Encompassing the natural Yuánqì of Heaven and Earth; all matters where the three combine and communicate, joining forces and minds; the method for the harmonious sovereignty and peaceful governance through the clear Tiānquàn.
"Zhēnrén, come forward.
Now that the auspicious and harmonious Qi has all arrived together,
people should simply roam and have no official duties.
By what means should they enlighten their hearts and rectify their intentions,
constantly making them suddenly forget to commit evil,
and daily love to do good,
without knowing how to stop?
To cause emperors and kings to rule by non-action without anything needing governance,
with people of supreme goodness filling their courts,
and loyal, trustworthy, and filial sons all fully present—
by what means should this be achieved?
You, Zhēnrén, have a natural disposition that loves goodness
and are always anxiously concerned for the Tiāndào.
You should refine yourself
and explain it in detail."
"Indeed.
One must simply apply oneself urgently to learning the Zhēndào, Zhēndé, and Zhēnrén. "
"Why should one learn the Zhēndào?"
"Indeed.
The Dào is able to guide and transform without precedence,
and its love for life is beyond measure.
Possessing the Zhēndào
is the name of supreme goodness;
whereas being without the Dào
is the name for the worst evils, decline, misfortune, transgression, and death."
"Zhēnrén, now you speak only of true goodness;
I have nothing to add to this.
Why should one learn Zhēndé?"
"When a person possesses Zhēndé,
it is the name for being able to encompass and nourish the infinite.
One who is without Dé
is the name for the most inferior, weak, destitute, and petty person."
"Excellent.
To the words of the Zhēnrén,
I again have nothing to add;
they are truly, truly so.
Why should one learn the Réndào?"
"One who is Rén
is capable of kindness and love
that encompasses everything without exception;
it is the name for simply delighting in giving without limit.
An unbenevolent person
turns against virtue and opposes the good scriptures;
this is the name for great greed and meanness.
Having the same intent as birds and beasts,
they have nothing by which to distinguish themselves."
"Excellent!
To the words of the Zhēnrén,
I again have nothing to add.
Now that the Zhēnrén has spoken of these three matters,
I have nothing to add to this.
Should people today learn to do good,
or should they not?"
"They should apply themselves diligently to learning to do good."
"As for doing good,
does it not also have names and designations?"
"This humble one is not up to the task;
I only ask the Shī to reveal it."
"Indeed.
One who does good
acts in accordance with the mind of Heaven
and does not go against the will of people;
this is called 'goodness'.
Goodness
is supremely transcendent and unsurpassed,
sharing the same name as the Dào.
It is what Heaven loves,
what Earth nourishes,
what emperors and kings should prioritize,
and what officials serving lords should work toward with one heart and united strength.
Evil
acts against the mind of Heaven
and constantly harms the will of people.
It loves to oppose the Tiāndào
and does not follow the Four Seasons.
It causes the Shénqí to hate it
and is a great harm that people do not wish for their parents to see.
It is the source of sorrow and suffering for the Jūnzǐ.
It is the name for the ultimate decline, misfortune, and ruin in the world.
Therefore, in human conduct,
if one loses auspiciousness, one immediately enters misfortune;
if one leaves misfortune, one enters auspiciousness.
Alternating between auspiciousness and misfortune,
and between good and evil,
makes one an impure and careless person.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Now, in the Zhēnrén's opinion,
how should the conduct of ordinary people be?"
"Indeed.
If people today do not apply themselves to learning the Dào,
they will have no knowledge of the Dào,
and will immediately be called 'people without the Dào'.
People without the Dào
are the most evil and calamitous people.
If they do not apply themselves to learning Dé,
they will have no knowledge of Dé.
People without Dé who love to harm and injure
are omens of misfortune and ruin.
If people today do not apply themselves to learning Rén,
they are already unbenevolent.
Unbenevolent people
travel the same path as birds and beasts.
When a person shares the same mind as birds and beasts,
they are only slightly better than the dead.
If people today do not apply themselves day and night to learning goodness,
when they lose goodness, they enter evil.
Evil is the place of death and calamity.
Therefore, if ordinary people do not apply themselves to learning auspiciousness,
they immediately enter misfortune.
Misfortune is an evil name throughout the world."
"Excellent!
You have already deeply entered the Zhēndào
and will no longer return to evil.
Now, why has the Zhēnrén for so long harbored wisdom while acting foolish?"
"I did not dare to act."
"You are fortunately capable.
You have fully explained what you have to say,
and I am very pleased by it.
Now that you can go to this extreme,
have you previously only looked at my words
and then abandoned them halfway and stopped?"
"I would not dare.
Seeing that the Shī has repeatedly ordered me to speak,
my understanding was simply insufficient,
so I did not dare to say everything."
"Excellent are your words;
you are always very humble."
"Now I can direct my mind fully to the Zhēnmén;
I only ask the Tiānshī to record and show me where I fall short."
"Indeed.
Everything you have just said is correct.
For this reason, the Great Sages and Sānhuáng of antiquity
themselves applied their efforts day and night to learning the Zhēndào.
When they saw someone who did not like learning the Zhēndào,
they named them 'people without the Dào'.
As for people without the Dào,
their conduct is unrestrained,
and they are the object of Heaven's great and heavy resentment.
As for people without the Dào,
Heaven originally did not wish to cover them,
Earth did not wish to support them,
the Shénlíng, Jīng, and Guǐ did not wish to protect them,
and they were a common suffering for the whole world.
Sages, worthies, and Jūnzǐ greatly detested people without the Dào.
Thus, in the time of the Shànghuáng of antiquity,
everyone learned Qīngjìng
and deeply understood the ultimate essence of Heaven and Earth.
Therefore, they all learned the Zhēndào
and subsequently attained the mind of Heaven and the intent of Earth.
If people do not apply themselves to learning Dé,
they are named 'people without Dé'.
As for people without Dé,
Heaven does not love them,
Earth does not delight in them,
and people do not wish to be close to them.
In their conduct, they constantly act without virtue.
They bring harm to kings
and disaster to the Jūnzǐ.
Guǐshén, following Heaven's instruction,
will not long allow them to govern.
For this reason, the worthies, sages, and great scholars of antiquity,
when they saw people without Dé,
would not engage in conversation with them.
If one does not apply oneself day and night to learning Rén,
then one will neglect one's affairs and become unbenevolent.
As for unbenevolent people,
their words go against all matters,
they injure people's hearts,
they do not accord with Heaven's intent,
and they are instead similar to birds and beasts.
Therefore, the sages and worthies of antiquity would not travel the same path as them.
If people today do not serve a Shī
and apply themselves to learning goodness,
they will be foolish and ignorant,
not knowing how to do good.
Instead, they will indulge their ignorant minds
and lightly commit evil.
As for evil people and those of the lowest foolishness and ignorance,
their conduct does not follow the way of Heaven and Earth.
Furthermore, they cause trouble for the Jūnzǐ,
bring ruin to their parents,
cause distress to their kin,
and act without laws.
Guǐshén, following the mind of Heaven as its messengers, do not delight in them.
The harm they cause is extreme in three respects,
and by law, they should be executed.
The sages and worthies of antiquity considered them a great grievance.
Therefore, those of antiquity all personally verified their own learning,
ensuring it accorded with the mind of Heaven.
Their affairs simply entered into Dào, Dé, Rén, and Shàn.
Their conduct essentially had to accord with the mind of Heaven and Earth,
and they did not speak of matters with superficiality.
The reason for this is
that if one loses the laws of Heaven,
once lost, one enters into misfortune and will have a short life,
or it may harm future generations.
The Tiāndào does not err;
it has fixed standards.
If one does not diligently study the Way of Great Fortune,
but instead treats matters with negligence and ease,
one will surely enter into misfortune.
Misfortune is something loathed by Heaven, Earth, humanity, and the myriad things;
it cannot long endure.
It is the root of great suffering
and the gateway to calamity.
To err and fall into it leads to death,
with no way to return, repent of one's faults, or restore the former state.
Everyone under Heaven knows this,
yet lower scholars and the extremely foolish
often mock the Way together.
They do not know how to guard the Way
to avoid misfortune and harm early on.
They pass on their folly,
inheriting the burden from one another.
Later generations are ignorant and deluded,
even more severely than those before.
Thus, the True Way is closed and obstructed,
causing people to be negligent
and unable to fulfill their natural lifespan.
Their great faults and errors
stem from this.
When a Zhēnrén sees my book,
they should contemplate it deeply
and be careful not to hide or conceal it.
Hand it over to the virtuous, gentle, and wise
so that they may attain enlightenment.
Therefore, the Ancient Way accords with the heart of Heaven
and follows the intent of Earth.
Because there were the methods of the Great True Way of high antiquity,
people were constantly taught to study the Way,
study Virtue,
study Longevity,
study Goodness,
study Prudence,
study Fortune,
study Antiquity,
study Peace,
and study Long Life.
The reason for fully detailing what is good is that
the law of Heaven
is to always open the door of the Way;
the law of Earth
is to always open the portal of Virtue.
The law of the sages and worthies of antiquity
was to always open the path of Benevolence.
Thus, the sages and worthies of old
were of one heart with Heaven
and one mind with Earth.
Together, they nurtured the twelve thousand things through long life,
always transmitting them with the intentions of the Way, Virtue, and Benevolence.
Thus, the myriad things could flourish.
If they are transmitted with intentions of misfortune and evil,
all things daily decline and diminish.
Therefore, where there are the Way, Virtue, and Benevolence,
the people daily increase and love goodness.
Where there is no Way, Virtue, or Benevolence,
the people daily decline and diminish,
and governance becomes daily more impoverished and miserable.
This is the suspended law and standard of Heaven and Earth.
Those with hearts of the Ultimate Way, Bright Virtue, and Benevolence
correspond above with the stars and calendar of Heaven,
and divine spirits illuminate their actions.
Thus, the sages and worthies of old always thought of doing good without limit,
exhausting their strength so that they dared not have evil thoughts or follow paths of misfortune.
As for the lowly and foolish,
their hearts are always obstructed.
They are truly ignorant
and must not be further led astray onto the evil paths of misfortune and decline.
They do not realize they have greatly lost the Way of Heaven,
following one another in evil as a common practice,
unable to withdraw from these customs.
Therefore, I have reverently received the teachings and commands of the Heavenly Books from above.
Following the heart of Heaven, I have opened it up,
opening wide the path of Tài Píng from high antiquity
to make people delight in doing good
and no longer know the arts of doing evil.
The people of the world often have high ambitions,
yet what they achieve is conversely low,
failing to correspond to their original aspirations.
Therefore, a Shàngshì indignantly loathes death and delights in life;
they go to study immortality
and through diligence can obtain longevity.
This Shàngshì is the foremost person of ambition.
A Zhōngshì has ambition;
they are distressed by their ancestors' premature deaths
and indignantly seek the Way to study longevity.
Through diligence, they fulfill their natural lifespan.
This is the foremost man of firm ambition.
Next are those with many illnesses who cannot maintain constant peace.
They indignantly go to study
what can stop it.
Through diligence, they can recover their former state.
Having been slightly distressed by illness,
they then study.
Thinking they can stop it,
they are already severely ill.
Next are those whose severe illness is critical,
who then seek the arts of the Way.
Those who might save themselves are already dead.
Thus, my book teaches people
the method of Heaven's long life.
If one exerts oneself day and night,
one may just barely attain peace.
If one studies with a "just average" method,
ordinary people will have already entered into misfortune.
The foolish do not know the original ambitions
of the ordinary people of the world.
They always think of those better and higher than themselves
but cannot match those aspirations.
Therefore, I hold up high standards for them,
reaching up to the level of immortals,
so that they may just barely manage to preserve their natural lifespan.
A great worthy aims for ten and gets ten;
they will surely correspond with my books of the Way.
A middle worthy aims for ten,
but might stop halfway or become negligent,
only getting five.
A small person aims for it in the morning
and forgets what they said by evening.
Therefore, those who set high standards
wish to let the superior, middle, and inferior classes each attain what their hearts aspire to.
Today, the people of the later ages are extremely foolish
and far from the True Way.
Even if they diligently study the correct texts and laws of Heaven,
they may just barely avoid falling into falsehood and deception.
If they study with "just average" texts,
they are already greatly deceived.
If they study with practiced texts and fine words,
great hypocrisy and cunning have already arisen.
Heaven regards Emperors and Kings as its sons
and loathes the lower deceiving the upper.
If the actions of the people below are full of deviance and falsehood,
then the virtuous and benevolent rulers above have no one to trust,
and the common people below have no one to whom they can entrust their lives.
If one diligently teaches the True Way day and night,
and diligently studies the Way of Goodness,
one only obtains a "just average" Way.
If one studies the "just average" Way,
one has already entered into superficiality.
Entering into superficiality,
ordinary people become greatly deluded and impoverished,
and it becomes a path of great misfortune and evil.
Emperors and Kings become grieved,
and the people cannot be governed.
If a Zhēnrén wishes to know this truth,
compare it to compassionate parents in a household.
They daily teach their children to do good,
suffering to the point of depriving themselves of food and clothing to raise them to old age,
yet the children remain stubbornly evil.
How much more so when ordinary people show and teach one another with superficial texts?
If you do not believe my book,
let the ordinary people who see it
each reflect on their own losses.
Since the middle ages,
those who possessed the Good Way have all taught one another to hide it,
unwilling to transmit it to their disciples.
Instead, they taught them with superficial and false texts.
This has accumulated for a long time;
therefore, the Way of Heaven is now uniquely in great chaos.
Calamities and anomalies of Heaven and Earth,
and the myriad species, do not occur without reason.
Virtuous Rú should each deeply reflect.
Although I do not dwell with the common people day and night,
I clearly know this already.
Because the world suffers greatly from this,
I have been made to produce this text to inform and entrust it;
I do not do this for nothing.
The Zhēnrén should truly be heavy and cautious,
or there will be Heavenly punishment."
"Yes, yes.
I would not dare.
Every time I see the Tiānshī speak,
I am always filled with awe and trembling."
"Your words are correct.
Thus, Heaven will be greatly pleased and joyful
and will not harm you."
"Yes, yes."
"Even if ordinary people diligently study day and night
and are commanded to be taught with True Virtue,
they still only barely attain average virtue.
If they study with average virtue,
they have already entered into deviant and false virtue.
If they study with deviant and false virtue,
the foolish people are already beyond count.
Without True Virtue,
they act according to their whims;
this is purely the thief of the gentleman.
If one diligently studies Superior Benevolence,
one only barely succeeds in becoming a Middle Benevolence.
If one diligently studies Middle Benevolence,
one's actions are just barely average,
and there is no Benevolence.
If one studies without Benevolence,
the foolish people have already become thieves and robbers.
They unknowingly kill and wound beyond count.
They act as they please
without using reason or the Way;
this is exactly the resentment of Heaven and the fault of Earth.
The great thief of humanity.
Striving morning and night to study the Way of Great Auspiciousness,
one only attains Middle Auspiciousness;
studying for Middle Auspiciousness,
one only attains Small Auspiciousness;
studying for Small Auspiciousness,
one has already entered the Way of Misfortune;
studying the Way of Misfortune,
one is beyond salvation.
All are greatly ignorant and know nothing;
seeing the *Tiāndào*, they say it is untrue,
merely deceiving and deluding those of pure faith.
Their foolish minds speak reckless words,
above, they offend the patterns of the heavens,
below, they disorder the patterns of the earth,
causing disasters and harm for the common people.
Therefore, my books of the Way instruct ordinary people
by teaching them on a grand scale,
so that the highest among them may rank as *Zhēnxiān*.
If they cannot reach the level of *Zhēnxiān*,
they may still obtain peace and safety,
and not be a cause of worry for a virtuous ruler.
*Zhēnrén* should deeply contemplate my words
and no longer find them strange."
"Yes, yes."
"Now I speak on behalf of Heaven
to fully explain the responsibility of *Chéngfù* since the opening and creation of Heaven and Earth.
If this cannot be widely expanded
through the methods of the Great *Dào* and Great Virtue,
the arts of supreme longevity,
and the path of supreme goodness,
humans will lose themselves in ignorance.
Indeed, for a long time they have trusted their foolish and clouded hearts;
people will gather to do evil,
and it cannot be prohibited,
and furthermore, they will be unable to resolve the blame and transgressions of the *Chéngfù* of Heaven and Earth.
Does the *Zhēnrén* understand my words?"
"Yes, yes."
"Now, sages, worthies, and high-minded gentlemen
see these writings and study them;
they will certainly correspond with the substance of my books
without a hair’s breadth of deviation.
The middling gentleman’s understanding reaches halfway
and he will certainly attain half;
the lower gentleman exerts himself,
and if diligent, can avoid losing the law;
this is how the people of Heaven are greatly uplifted.
Among ordinary people, those who delight in not losing the law—whether high, low, or middling—
all attain the *Zhèngdào*.
Each cherishes themselves
and dares not treat matters lightly, causing great worry.
When a high gentleman attains my Way
and studies it without ceasing,
he can become a fine minister of the state;
after a long time, he attains its essential meaning
and can transcend the world,
no longer engaging in disputes or eyeing power.
When a middling gentleman studies my Way,
he can become a good and virtuous minor official
and can complete his natural lifespan.
When a common person studies my Way,
he can be perpetually cautious:
the father is compassionate and the mother is loving,
the son is filial and the elder brother is good,
the younger brother is submissive,
husband and wife share the same plans,
not harming or injuring each other.
Until death, there is no resentment.
Their souls dwell beneath the earth,
yet they remain enduring;
they are no longer seen being put to labor,
nor are they known as wicked children,
and there are none who die young or are executed.
In ancient times, when the *Yuánqì* was first born of Heaven,
everyone delighted in studying and desired to be immortals,
yet they still could not all achieve longevity;
it only caused people to fear death
and refrain from violating penal laws.
Now, the people of the later ages are greatly foolish;
instead, they recite superficialities and teach one another,
collectively studying pursuits that do not grant longevity.
During their lives, they are heedless,
saying to themselves as if they will never die.
On the contrary, they teach each other
that there is nothing to cherish,
and together they promote inauspicious matters,
valuing the management of death and mourning more than life.
Life belongs to Heaven,
while death belongs to Earth;
to serve Earth more than one's Heaven
is a great harm.
I observe and divine based on this
and know they have all been foolish for a very long time,
knowing nothing at all.
When inauspicious matters arise,
then ghosts greatly flourish
and together they rapidly kill people,
so that people cannot complete their *Tiānmìng*.
Now, by striving to study the *Zhēndào*,
one only attains a false way;
by striving to study *Zhēndé*,
one only attains a false virtue.
How much more so for the people of later ages,
who instead teach each other with superficial writings?
How far they are from the Way!
In their distress and poverty, they can no longer restrain one another,
instead teaching each other to create petitions and laws,
using cleverness and debate to argue over merits and defects.
Now, when teaching them to be *Rén*,
one still worries they will be inhumane;
how much more so when teaching them the path of inhumanity!
Heaven hangs down the law for humanity;
Heaven itself is named the *Dàdào*,
and Earth itself is named *Dé*.
The reason for this is that
Heaven and Earth
are the father and mother of the myriad things.
In all matters of serving rulers and elders,
they always guide with goodness;
they do not dare to open up paths
to teach the way of misfortune and evil—
how much more so should this apply to humans?
Humans
are the children of Heaven;
they should model their conduct after Heaven.
Now they have lost the law;
therefore, people are difficult to govern.
If they were guided by *Dào* and *Dé*,
it would cause them to have knowledge, to respect themselves, cherish themselves, love themselves, and govern themselves.
Now, instead, they are opened up to penal laws,
causing them to view death with indifference,
valuing bravery and strength while treating themselves lightly;
they are made to govern one another in succession,
thus causing mutual distress,
and they even turn to mutual destruction and harm,
repeatedly bringing sorrow and suffering upon each other.
Therefore, none in the world love one another;
the great fault lies here.
Does the *Zhēnrén* know this?
Be cautious of it."
"Yes, yes."
"Now, even when forcefully commanding and teaching them to be *Rén*,
one still suffers from their lack of benevolence.
People of later ages instead teach each other calculations and books,
which are already very shallow;
their mutual hatred and resentment cannot be ended.
Forcefully teaching them to be auspicious,
one still suffers from inauspiciousness.
People of later ages instead command each other to strive in studying the implements of death and mourning,
preparing for inauspicious matters in anticipation.
They die daily without reaching their full lifespan,
almost to the point of family extermination,
yet they do not know their own faults and errors.
When the time comes, they cry out to Heaven and wail to Earth,
saying they are wronged
and that the King's governance is unjust;
yet losing one's years is something brought upon oneself by one's inner conduct.
Foolish people do not guard the root;
they only repent when their guilt is fixed.
If they were not cautious, it is of no use then;
even if they wail until their mouths are dead,
they still cannot be saved.
Therefore, I now forcefully command and teach with the Way of the Great Immortals' Scriptures,
only just opening the stairs to longevity.
Teaching people with *Dé*
only just makes them *Rén*;
teaching people with *Rén*
only just makes them maintain mediocrity;
for that reason, they dare not deceive others or seize their property.
Teaching people through mediocrity,
one has already lost the law;
teaching people through the law,
one has already lost to mutual destruction;
teaching people mutual destruction,
one has already entered the Great Martiality.
Entering Great Martiality,
then the people are deceived even without guilt,
and their distress makes them into thieves and bandits.
Therefore, I uphold the laws of the *Tiāndào*,
opening the gate of Great Auspiciousness
and closing the path of misfortune and evil,
opening the stairs of the *Tàipíng* of Heaven,
so that every person recites them
and each is cautious of themselves;
there will be no need for further governance,
causing the seasons of Heaven to revolve,
and the happy King will wander long without any concerns.
Therefore, my books fully examine the fundamental origin of all things,
only just attaining the middle;
examining the middle,
one has already attained the lower;
studying below the level of foolish people
is already great chaos.
Now, in the later ages,
the reason why emperors and kings, though they possess the *Dàodé* of ten thousand upon ten thousand people
and their benevolent thoughts match the heart of Heaven,
find that misfortune does not cease,
is that the *Chéngfù* of flowing disasters and chaos has accumulated for a very long time.
Although they are distressed and torment themselves thinking about it,
desiring to find joy in a single principle,
The myriad categories of portents and bandits,
and the Yídí disturbing the Xià,
are the failures of the former kings;
they were not caused by one person alone.
One must deeply understand their root.
Therefore, Heaven has caused me to bring forth this book
to resolve the transgressions of inherited burdens for the Dìwáng.
The Zhēnrén might think that my Dào does not correspond with Heaven;
but now, simply act according to my text,
without the slightest error,
and there will be an immediate response.
This text of mine is highly trustworthy.
If one does not strive to practice it to untie the knots of grievances,
how could the Way of Heaven respond in silence and emptiness?
If one is foolish and does not learn,
how can they become worthy?
If one is poor and does not plow,
how can they have a harvest?
Learning immediately leads to worthiness;
plowing immediately leads to a harvest.
Practicing my book
is just like this.
I guarantee it.
Do not seek worthiness without learning,
and do not seek a harvest without plowing.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"The Zhēndào is based on uprightness;
Dàdé promotes Rén,
and everything finds its proper place.
Regarding peaceful governance,
not a single thing is lost.
Does the Zhēnrén understand yet?
Those who wish to repay the merits of Heaven and Earth and obtain long life
must strive to believe in the Dào and never be slack."
"Yes, yes.
Now I, this humble student, wish to ask something else,
but I dare not speak abruptly."
"Proceed."
"Now, how does the Tiānshī know when people are utterly without Dào, Dé, or Rén?"
"Excellent is your question;
observe how that person acts and speaks."
"I wish to hear of it."
"Indeed.
When someone sees a Dàorén and reacts with anger and criticism,
know that they are someone completely devoid of the Dào.
When they see Dé and criticize or loathe it,
know they are a person utterly without Dé.
When they see Rén and criticize it,
know they are a greatly evil person without Rén.
When they see careful goodness and criticize it,
know they are an incautious and non-good person.
By natural instinct:
All those of like mind love one another,
while those of different minds hate one another.
Good people are distressed by evil people,
and evil people are distressed by good people.
Does the Zhēnrén understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"In ancient times, when the Shèngxián met a person,
they did not immediately speak with them,
but only carefully observed their likes and dislikes to know them.
It is precisely by using this to mirror their conduct
that one never fails in ten thousand instances."
"Excellent!"
"Therefore, the Dào
shares the same bone structure and bloodlines as Huángtiān.
Thus, the Way of Heaven loathes evil and loves life.
Consequently, evil creates a heavy grievance with Heaven.
The Earth shares the same bone structure and bloodlines as Dé.
Thus, those who harm others
create a great offense against the Earth.
Rén shares the same bone structure and bloodlines as the Shèngxián.
Thus, the Shèngxián love to practice Rén and loathe taking by force.
Therefore, doing so creates a great enmity with the Shèngxián and Rén.
For this reason, the Shèngxián of old
deeply understood that these were the actions governed by the Sāntǒng.
Therefore, in establishing laws,
they did not dare to deviate from the Zhēndào, Dé, and Rén.
Thus, the movement of Heaven works together with the Sìshí.
Heaven moves the Qì,
and the Sìshí also move the Qì.
They share the same heart.
Therefore, those who go against the Sìshí
create a grievance with Heaven.
The Earth shares the same heart and strength as the Wǔxíng
to jointly nourish all things.
When things have not reached their natural end
and are harmed,
it creates a great offense against the Earth.
The Shèngxián share the same heart and strength as Rén.
Thus, in their daily lives, they always honor the Dào and value Dé,
and they rely upon Rén for their dwelling.
If a person loves to take by force and lacks Rén,
they are the enemies and foes of the Shèngxián.
Thus, Fire is the Heart,
and the Heart is sagely.
Therefore, Fire always relies upon Wood to dwell.
Wood is Rén and possesses a heart.
Fire has light
and can discern right from wrong.
The Heart is sagely and bright.
Thus, the great Shèngxián of old
always relied upon Rén and brightness for their dwelling,
and they turned toward rulers who possessed Dào, Dé, and Rén.
Therefore, I give this serious warning.
Let the Zhēnrén entrust my book to a ruler who possesses Dào, Dé, Rén, and brightness.
He will certainly enjoy and love my Dào,
deeply understand its meaning,
and by following and emulating it,
he will be no different from a spirit.
I do not praise myself to the Zhēnrén;
if practiced, the response
will surely match like a compass and square.
Then, people of later ages will remember my words."
"Yes, yes."
"Go forth and practice it,
strive for it and be diligent.
Work hard at learning the Dào, Dé, and Rén.
There is nothing else that needs doing.
Bring forth this book,
and do not let it be hidden."
"Yes, yes."
This section clarifies the hearts of the Shèngxián to resolve foolish darkness; those who have doubts should seek resolution here.
The Liùduān Zhēnrén bowed his head twice and respectfully said:
"I venture to ask the Shànghuáng Shénrén about seeking the truth.
I wish to make Heaven and Earth peaceful,
prevent Yīnyáng from being in disorder,
and ensure they always follow their course.
I wish for disasters not to arise recklessly,
and for the king to spend his days in leisure,
as the constant practice of great joy.
Although I have asked many questions about matters high and low,
may I hear more?"
"Excellent! How deep
is your question!
How thoroughly it reaches the secret!
You are asking exactly about this essential meeting.
Do you wish to advance to the Zhìdào and discard false texts?"
"Indeed."
"I shall now explain it all.
You have accumulated goodness before Heaven;
how would I dare to hide it?
Now, out of concern for your goodness
and to fathom the mind of the spirit-light,
if I did not speak or act,
I fear I would go against the will of Heaven.
Since Heaven has caused you to seek and ask,
I will provide a detailed and distinct explanation for you.
Follow it and record it,
and be careful not to omit anything.
If the Dìwáng can use my book,
all disasters will be eliminated in a single morning.
The whole world will be joyful,
and all will wish to be scholars of the Dào and Dé.
Later generations will emulate the former ages.
Old and young will follow one another in rising up,
and all will come to know how to seek the Zhēnwén and examine matters.
Superficiality will vanish.
Their hearts will thoroughly harmonize with the divine spirits.
The ruler will not have a single worry;
why then would he not spend his days in leisure?
In this way, in all matters of Heaven and Earth,
everything will find its place.
The Bǎishén will therefore be joyful.
The king will deeply grasp the intent of Heaven,
and the Zhìdào will come to assist him.
There will only be auspicious days,
and not a single unlucky event.
My words are truly sincere,
never failing in ten thousand instances.
I only fear that if it is obtained but not practiced,
the various evils will become knotted.
Disasters, anomalies, and superficiality
are the great illnesses of Heaven, Earth, and Yīnyáng.
If a great illness is not treated,
how can it be cured?
Since you have come to ask about these matters
for the sake of Heaven's words,
you must think carefully on the language of my book from beginning to end.
I hope you have the utmost intent;
be careful not to throw it into disorder."
"Yes, yes."
Having truly found a convenient place to return to,
I thought about it day and night.
Having been transmitted the record,
I repeatedly revised and drafted it,
hoping that it would never be lost for ten thousand generations.
Since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
speech, writing, and texts
have followed one after another.
In all matters,
those of the same Qì clarify one another according to their category.
If one seeks their category and gathers them together,
the Dào will become clearer every day
and will never have a time of decline.
Therefore, from ancient times to the present,
all the holy ones have shared in heavenly discourse,
and all the worthies have used the same words,
collectively planning for the sake of the sagely
Dìwáng,
who are the noble sons of Heaven.
The son receives the father's teachings
and should follow them obediently
to remove the worries of Heaven and Earth
and thereby obtain their protection;
thus, one should always think of putting them into practice.
Is this my Dào?
When observing matters, one must be perceptive;
if one is not perceptive of the spirits of Heaven and Earth,
one must further seek through billions and millions,
thousands and hundreds, tens and ones.
All matters must correspond with one another,
and only then can they be carefully judged as usable.
If they do not correspond,
urgently seek again
among their related types;
that which finds correspondence
without a single failure
is the correct one.
"All matters should be like this;
how can one carefully know their correspondence?"
"Correspondence
means that one should internally investigate the heart
and externally respond to the Shénqí;
far and near move each other,
and when using divination to verify below,
those that respond are correct;
those that do not respond,
their explanations are all false.
Be cautious and do not speak recklessly,
lest it cause a person to have no descendants in later generations.
The reason for this is
that the explanations of reckless words have no future
and cannot be used for long;
thus, they cause a person to have no descendants.
The way of governance declines daily;
perversity and rebellion all arise from deviant words;
this is truly wrong.
All those that disrupt the patterns of Heaven and the geography of Earth,
and do not correspond to the heart of the Sage,
cannot be employed by the spirits.
Therefore, when speaking,
one must internally investigate human emotions and the heart,
and then externally harmonize,
investigating the Shénqí.
Those that are correct
are the gains and losses held in one's hands,
which are the warnings of the heavenly patterns.
Accumulate writings and group them by category;
have the worthies gather them,
selecting those where ten out of ten correspond,
and those that correspond to the human heart and the Shénqí to be used as texts.
Together settle their meaning
and test them by verification;
in this way, they will be unchangeable for ten thousand generations.
Verification
refers to divination that responds
and practice where the response arrives;
this is it.
Then one can establish the Tiānjīng and laws,
which is precisely what is called the great art of harmonizing and stabilizing Yīnyáng and pacifying the Wángzhě.
This can turn misfortune into blessing
and make the people live longer.
"Why is this so?"
"When the heavenly patterns and earthly geography are correct,
then Yīn and Yáng each find their proper place;
when Yīn and Yáng each find their proper place,
then the Shénlíng are all greatly pleased;
when the Shénlíng are pleased,
they protect the people;
therefore, the Dìwáng enjoys long-lasting peace and the people have longevity.
How can one not strive diligently?
"As for the Fēimíng,
they are the smallest of the three luminaries;
they are all connected to the earth below
and suspended from Heaven above.
Their movements harmonize and correspond with the earth, the people, and the ten thousand things;
this is the proof of the essential texts.
When the writings of books and the divination of matters
correspond hundred by hundred and ten by ten, they are correct;
those that do not correspond or harmonize are false.
Use this as a measure to balance them,
and the heterodox texts and books will all be completely eliminated.
Take past matters to verify present ones;
follow what Heaven allows to be done,
observe what Heaven allows to rise,
do not disrupt the patterns of Heaven,
and work in unison with the power of Heaven;
this can be called long-lasting auspiciousness.
For Heaven can only be followed and not resisted;
by profiting from what it makes profitable,
one causes people to flourish;
resisting it causes people to decline,
and losing the intent of Heaven leads to death."
All texts concerning migration and movement
are Tiānxíngshū;
when Yīn and Yáng intersect and join,
the patterns of Heaven are formed.
Dìwáng, the people, and the ten thousand things
all act within their principles;
those who grasp their intent are auspicious,
and those who lose their intent are all inauspicious.
Matters have resistance and compliance;
one must be cautious and thorough.
To know them with certainty,
test them with the twenty-five matters of five times five;
take twenty-five ancient stories
and the deeds of twenty-five families;
record in detail the years, months, days, and times of their origin,
and to whose hand the Wǔyīn belong;
use this to divine auspiciousness and inauspiciousness,
and those that correspond hundred by hundred and ten by ten are correct.
This ensures the dividing principles of Heaven and Earth are settled, and the Wángzhě
will have no doubts.
The people and ministers will not lose their duties,
and the ten thousand things will each find their place.
If it is not as this book says,
then the texts of disorder and heterodoxy cannot be used.
Use this as a measure;
as for texts that mislead people,
if any dare to use them,
they will have no sons in later generations.
The reason for this is
that they harm and injure the people
and lose the divisions of Heaven and Earth.
Heaven and Earth preside over life,
but humans instead disrupt their Yīnyáng;
therefore, it causes a person to have no descendants.
In ancient times, there were no writings,
and Heaven traced back to the origin;
after the appearance of the Tiānxíngshū,
everyone already knew the intent of the Dào of Heaven,
yet those who deliberately violate it
will mostly die young and meet with misfortune;
this is exactly it.
Bestowing has its related types,
which correspond and harmonize by category;
the Wǔyuè correspond over ten thousand miles.
With refined and detailed contemplation and thought,
among them, good things correspond with good,
and lowly things harmonize with lowly;
their quantity, height, or lowliness
will not fail once in ten thousand times.
Always verify with the twenty-five Qì of five times five,
which correspond to twenty-five families
and twenty-five hills and mounds;
where the writings correspond by tens and hundreds,
these are the Dìchèn.
When their Qì are compared and added together,
they are brother lands.
The likes and dislikes of their people are the same.
Furthermore, the various colors, birds, beasts, grasses, and trees are of the same type;
this is the land of the same Qì.
By making this clear,
the earth certainly corresponds, and
as for the related types of water Qì,
whose fish and turtles are of the same type—
use this for divination
to distinguish their origins,
and all the ten thousand things and matters
can be known.
Those whose images are the same
have the same form;
those whose images are different
have different forms;
right and wrong are exactly this.
As for the Dānmíngyào,
they are the characters carved by Heaven;
they can save from wrong and resist evil.
Those where ten out of ten correspond and heal
are heavenly scripts,
which correspond with the true Shénlì;
ancient stories verify this.
Those where nine out of ten heal are earthly scripts,
which harmonize with the Yīnshén.
Those where eight out of ten correspond and heal
are the Zhōnghé human scripts.
Use this to verify them;
the rest are all heterodox texts
and cannot be used,
as they are texts that support evil.
They should correspond with the spirits;
those that do not heal all mislead people
and cannot save from death.
Perhaps there are scripts and texts sent by ghosts and spirits
that heal without being understood;
this is because the person's own destiny and luck make them a leader of the heterodox,
and other people cannot use those scripts and texts.
Is it because of this that one verifies the gathering of many carved scripts and texts
indeed?
They should be carved and entirely sent to uninhabited wild places.
These texts should be sought one by one;
they cannot be obtained suddenly.
Herbs and plants that possess virtue, the *Dào*, and official rank
can be commanded and employed;
these are called herbal prescriptions,
and they are referred to as divine herbs and plants.
Those that heal an ailment immediately
are the divine herbs and plants of Heaven,
though they reside and grow upon the earth below.
Those that immediately extend one's years
are the celestial herbs and plants of Heaven,
though they reside and grow upon the earth below.
Those that heal an ailment with a decisive and immediate cure
are named Prescriptions of Immediate Healing;
those that heal within one day
are named Prescriptions for Healing in One Day;
these are the ones that correspond and heal in every ten or hundred cases.
These herbs and plants possess spirit and essence
and can be commanded by one another;
they are herbs and plants of official rank.
Those that correspond and heal in ten out of ten cases
are *Dìwáng* herbs;
those that correspond in nine out of ten cases
are *Dàchén* herbs;
those that correspond in eight out of ten cases
are *Rénmín* herbs;
those below this level
cannot be used,
as they are herbs that mislead people.
This is the art of saving life from death
and must be scrutinized in detail.
When a prescription is harmoniously blended and heals immediately,
record its herbs and plants,
and name it an Immediate Healing Prescription;
that which heals in one day
is named a One-Day Healing Prescription;
that which heals in two days
is named a Two-Day Prescription;
that which heals in three days
is named a Three-Day Prescription.
For the prescription that heals in one day,
one employs the heavenly spirits to treat it;
for the prescription that heals in two days,
one employs the earthly spirits to treat it;
for the prescription that heals in three days,
one employs human ghosts to treat it.
Those not like these
are not prescriptions of heavenly spirits,
but merely treat with raw botanical juices;
they may or may not heal,
and are named Prescriptions for Awaiting Death.
Be cautious, be cautious.
This is the art of saving the life-mandate from death;
it cannot be changed,
and the matter must be scrutinized in detail.
Living beings that circulate essence,
meaning the classes of flying, walking, and crawling creatures,
can also immediately heal diseases.
As for birds,
the divine medicine of Heaven resides within their bodies;
Heaven makes them travel in circles and squares.
Those that heal in ten out of ten cases
have heavenly spirit prescriptions within their bodies;
those that heal in nine out of ten cases
have earthly essence prescriptions within their bodies;
those that heal in eight out of ten cases
have human essence and harmonized divine medicine within their bodies.
These three
act as the prescriptions that circulate the harmony of Heaven, Earth, and *Yīnyáng*;
they are named Messengers Who Cure Illness.
This is comparable to a person of the *Dào* being called a messenger,
a *Shénrén* or a *Shénshī*.
These are employed by the essences and ghosts of Heaven, Earth, and Man;
those that are obtained and heal in ten out of ten or a hundred out of a hundred cases
are the divine prescriptions of the *Dìwáng Shànghuáng*;
those that heal in nine out of ten cases
are the divine prescriptions of *Wánghóu*;
those that heal in eight out of ten cases
are the divine prescriptions of *Dàchén*, *Báiyī*, or *Zhìdé Chùshì*.
Each has its own origin;
if one observes them using this,
not one in ten thousand will be missed.
These three categories all circulate divine medicine for Heaven, Earth, and Man to treat disease;
Heaven causes each to receive the mandate of their ancestors
and manifest the arts of nature,
which cannot be discarded.
It is comparable to the *Fènghuáng* and *Qílín*,
who manifest virtue in their bodies;
or comparable to bees and scorpions,
who manifest poison in their bodies;
this is what is meant.
One must deeply understand the most essential intent of the *Tiāndào*,
then one can be clear about the nature of the *Tiāndào*,
benefit the rule of the *Dìwáng*,
and prevent people from being confused.
If one does not know the essential writings
and merely claims that any worldly documents
are all usable,
then those at seven out of ten and below are all heterodox;
they do not correspond with the three auspicious signs
and their harm is profound.
Therefore, one who treats ten and harms one
has not attained the intent of Heaven's heart;
one who harms two in ten
has not attained the intent of Earth;
one who harms three in ten
has not attained the intent of Man;
those who harm six or seven or more out of ten
all represent chaotic treatment.
*Yīnyáng* will become perverse and rebellious because of it,
and the spirits will battle because of it.
For this reason, the *Shèngwáng* and *Dìzhǔ* of old,
though residing in secluded rooms,
deeply contemplated the intent of Heaven's heart
to preserve themselves
and attain long life and many years.
In my book, the words are gathered and interspersed to form a text;
let the wise and bright read it to supplement one another;
this is to rescue the deluded,
make people forever auspicious and distant from harm;
each should contemplate its most essential intent morning and night
to preserve their person.
As for the children’s songs and poems performed by the common people of past and present,
when Heaven undergoes changes,
it causes them to have these words;
when divine books occasionally appear,
Heaven transmits its discourse
to entrust it to those of perfect virtue,
to save the world from its errors.
The *Tiāndào* detests killing and loves life;
all classes of crawling things have awareness;
do not lightly kill or injure them for use;
if there are prescriptions requiring injury and transformation
that must be used to accomplish a matter,
use them only when there is no other choice.
Thus, the myriad things are numerous;
their mandate is tied to Heaven,
their roots are in the Earth,
but their use and pacification lie with Man;
those who attain Heaven's intent live long,
and those who lose Heaven's intent perish.
All things follow Heaven and Earth as the constant;
Man is their king;
for one who is a king and elder of men,
one cannot but be scrutinizing and detailed.
To understand the intended meaning of all scriptures and documents of the *Dào*,
correctly take one character and pursue it to its conclusion.
For example, what is the nature of *Jiǎzǐ*?
Place it before you,
have one person take charge of speaking its origin,
and let many wise men together debate and explain it;
those who have a specialized strength in the intent of astronomy
will explain it by ascending
and investigating it to the end of the *Tiāndào*;
some will have a strength in geography,
explaining it by descending
and thoroughly investigating it to the end of the *Dìdào*;
some will have a strength in lateral movements,
investigating to the end of the four directions;
some will explain from a seated position,
investigating the center;
some will trace matters to their source,
being strong in the essence of the myriad things,
and investigate all things;
some will investigate the internal,
and some will investigate the external,
until the origin and the end, the roots and foundations, the flowers and leaves have all been seen,
and all are named according to their categories and images.
When the ultimate meaning of all matters in the book
and the writings of Heaven, Earth, and *Yīnyáng*
can be roughly seen,
then their head and feet are both complete,
linked above and connected below;
categories of things have their natural state;
thus they jointly settle their meaning,
each writing their words,
and the good ones are collected into a single doctrine.
Therefore, the Sage wishes to obtain the intent of the *Tiāndào*
to regulate and fix *Yīnyáng*
and stabilize the king,
making the world peaceful
and causing the many spirits to be universally delighted;
thus the glory of many wise men is gathered and integrated into a constant law,
which cannot be changed for ten thousand generations.
The reason the intent of the *Tiāndào* is lost today
is that for a wise person,
the words of one individual
only know how to reach one side;
their brilliance does not see everything,
they cannot use it to flow through the six directions,
nor can they thoroughly investigate and reach the seven internal and external places,
and they are not yet able to command the essence of the myriad things;
thus they each hold different views,
causing the heavenly books to lose their original text,
and those who are confused and deluded
are precisely because of this.
Whenever one wishes to correct matters,
each has its own root
that can be exhaustively investigated.
Yīn and Yáng do not easily reverse;
everything should be like this.
If not,
it is called a "solitary theory" or "isolated speech,"
failing to grasp the intent of the classics.
Following the words of a single person
is called "partial speech."
Regarding the nature of Heaven and Earth,
none but a Shèng Rén can speak alone and communicate the intent of Heaven.
Therefore, if one is made to explain,
internally they cannot investigate the heart of Heaven,
and externally they cannot interpret Tiān Wén or Dì Lǐ.
In using divination to predict, they do not hit the mark;
the spirits and divinities do not serve them.
Losing the correct path,
they follow the way of delusion.
Thus it is called approaching superficiality,
failing to reach the shared root and ultimate intent.
The error lies here,
causing the simple-minded to lose their foundation.
It causes Tiān Dào to lose its correctness,
and Yīn and Yáng internally and exclusively become diseased.
Discordant and harmful Qì arise repeatedly,
and Dì Wáng are distressed; their hearts
cannot stop it.
Anomalous Qì continues to act,
the people do not live long,
and this is considered a great calamity.
The worthy and enlightened together lose the heart of Heaven.
Furthermore, they have been separated from the Shèng Rén for a long time,
so they cannot attain their proper principles.
This is called the way of disorder.
The reason for this is that
the classics and all records
are jumbled before and after
while discussing Heaven and Earth.
The head and beginning of all matters
is the root of the spirits and divinities.
Therefore, those who obtain the original intent
will find that spirits and divinities no longer war in anger or harm people;
then evil Qì will be hidden away,
and theft will be severed.
When thieves and bandits stop,
then the Yí and Dí will submit and surrender.
Wind and rain will come in their proper seasons;
this is the clear effect of Heaven’s joy.
When joyful, Heaven loves its children.
Therefore, Dì Wáng extend their lives,
grace flows to their people,
reaching the six domestic animals, birds, and beasts,
and exhaustively reaching the plants and trees.
When Hé Qì appears everywhere,
then evil Qì vanishes,
and correct Qì becomes even brighter.
This is the natural method of Yīn and Yáng.
It is like using the day for affairs
and hiding during the night;
when petty people flee,
the Jūn Zǐ acts.
Carefully contemplate these words;
these words are why lifespan is increased,
clearly explaining Yīn and Yáng and describing the spirits.
If you think my book is not so—
the Way is proven through trial,
wanting to know its successes and failures.
Now, try taking one copy of the book,
place it before them,
and have all the worthies collectively challenge and discuss it.
When their intended meanings differ
and their explanations of matters vary,

is clearly not enlightened.
How can such a person regulate Yīn and Yáng
and allow the Wáng Zhě to roam in effortless joy?
Thus, those who hold to the root are few
and those who speak are many,
so there is nothing that is not exhausted.
When those who hold to the root are many and those who speak are few,
it causes the Way to become superficial and shallow day by day;
if it remains shallow without stopping,
disorder follows.
If disorder does not stop,
Yīn and Yáng are not pleased,
and evil Qì then arises.
Therefore, the Shèng Wáng should value the root,
and the Jūn Zǐ should correct the beginning,
then nothing will be unregulated.
If one does not value and honor the root,
nor correct the beginning,
then all affairs will lose their order,
and the myriad things will fall into chaotic confusion,
impossible to regulate again.
Refine it and clarify it,
and the way of delusion and evil books will vanish.
Heaven and Earth have constant laws,
not erring by a tiny fraction.
Far and near all have the same images, and categories of Qì respond to one another,
not missing one in ten thousand.
It is named the Tiān Wén Jì,
and called the Tiān Shū.
Millions upon millions, thousands upon thousands, hundreds upon hundreds, tens upon tens—
just as twelve days complete one Zhōu Zǐ, it is so;
twelve years completing one Zhōu Zǐ is also so;
sixty years completing one Zhōu Zǐ is also so;
one hundred and twenty years completing one Zhōu Zǐ is also so.
Some cycles of billions are the same,
some cycles of millions are the same,
some cycles of thousands are the same,
some cycles of hundreds are the same,
some cycles of tens are the same,
all are like the Jiǎ Zǐ.
Their Qì differs,
their affairs differ,
their words differ,
their songs and poems differ.
Although all are Jiǎ Zǐ,
the Qì has not actually completed its cycle,
therefore they are different.
Categorize them by images and name them;
when good and evil share the same Qì, same words, and same affairs, that constitutes one cycle.
Carefully examine and align these;
this is how one clarifies the past
and further knows the present;
by knowing the present,
one in turn clarifies the past further.
This is how one knows the constant movement of Heaven,
clearly and penetratingly reaching the principles of Yīn and Yáng.
If the words of the book are erroneous or
inconsistent, they should be supplemented by each other.
When the songs, sounds, and affairs are all identical,
this is what is called the method of Dà Zhōu, Zhōng Zhōu, and Xiǎo Zhōu.
Obtaining the meaning
and regulating the affairs
to harmonize Yīn and Yáng
and pacify the Wáng Zhě—
this is a book that can verify the constant laws of Heaven.
It is like Spring, Autumn, Winter, and Summer,
which never error again.
Nowadays, later generations all have short lifespans;
having not witnessed even one cycle,
how could they know the three cycles of Dà, Xiǎo, and Zhōng?
Was the Shén Dào constant in antiquity?
Thus they lose the correct path,
seeing only a brief moment,
and failing to penetrate the divine writings of ancient and modern times.
They follow partial words
and claim they are correct.
It is just like a child born in Spring who dies
without seeing Autumn affairs;
or one born in Summer who ends
without seeing Winter affairs.
Speakers of the time each see what is visible
before their eyes;
therefore, even if ten of them debate it,
they still do not know,
for internally it is not so.
If the Tiān Wén are not verified,
this is the reason.
Affairs are not seen in vain;
at times there are writings of order or disorder.
The Way does not emerge in vain;
it is the movement of time that makes it so.
Therefore, the works of ancient poets
are all the flowing Qì of Heaven,
making their words not in vain.
Thus, the Shèng Xián Dì Wáng of antiquity
saw the subtle and knew the manifest,
acting according to the situation,
following the Qì,
and thus attaining the heart and intent of Heaven.
Therefore, they enjoyed long-lasting auspiciousness.
Opposing it leads to conflict between the Qì of floods and droughts,
disaster accumulates,
and strange transformations cannot be stopped.
These are called Zāi Yì.
The many worthies are confused,
not knowing it is simply because of opposing the Qì and not following the duties of the season.
One must be extremely cautious!
The reason Heaven provides later generations with records
is that the people of former times knew the dawn of life and nature
and entered the way of emptiness and stillness.
Thus they knew the meaning of the completion of Heaven’s Way,
just as Spring, Autumn, Winter, and Summer are constant.
In later generations, the flow of Qì has been long,
their learning is shallow,
and they are far removed from the writings of the essential Way.
Forgetting the path of former commands,
they are not Shén Shèng people.
They cannot foresee the completion of a cycle.
Thus Heaven again produces writings to record it, passing them down
through the ages so they may be followed
and enjoyed, wishing for them to know this so as to find peace for themselves.
Meeting with times of great peace,
one can then govern with a peaceful pillow;
meeting with average times,
one can then act with effort;
meeting with times of unrest,
one can then use the Dào to assist oneself and prepare for them.
It is just as preparing for heat at the Summer Solstice
and preparing for cold at the Winter Solstice;
this is what is meant.
The Tiāndào has constant movements
and does not change for the sake of man.
Therefore, following it leads to good fortune and prosperity,
while opposing it leads to danger and ruin.
When the Tiāndào is in conflict,
its mandate is damaged;
the sun and moon lose their regularity,
and the various stars move in disorder.
Knowing how to follow the seasonal Qì,
the sun and moon regain their regularity,
and the various stars move in order;
this is the clear evidence of Heaven.
Those who are capable should exert themselves,
not daring to hide their talents,
being careful not to cause harm.
The secret books of Heaven
are bestowed upon the benevolent and worthy,
clarifying the origins above and below,
allowing them to find peace.
Moxibustion and acupuncture
are the means to regulate and stabilize the three hundred and sixty vessels,
harmonizing the Qì of Yīnyáng and eliminating harm.
These three hundred and sixty vessels
correspond to the three hundred and sixty days of a year;
each day one vessel takes charge,
moving in response to the four seasons and the Wǔxíng,
circulating externally around the body,
converging at the crown of the head,
and connecting internally to the Zàng.
Their decline or abundance moves and shifts according to the four seasons;
if there is illness, they do not respond, and their measures
and movements lose regularity,
becoming knotted or damaged,
or moving in accordance or opposition;
therefore, they must be treated.
Moxibustion
is the essence of Tàiyáng
and the brightness of justice;
it is the means to investigate treachery and eliminate harm and evil.
Acupuncture
is the essence of Shǎoyīn
and the light of Tàibái;
it is the means to use righteousness for cutting and striking.
To hit the mark a hundred times out of a hundred,
or ten out of ten,
is to have obtained Heaven's classic texts and prognostications on the vessels;
if they truly correspond with the vessels,
then the Shén will be at one's service.
To succeed in nine out of ten and lose one
corresponds with the Yīn vessels,
and the Jīng will be at one's service.
To succeed in eight out of ten
is the way of human books,
and human intention will be at one's service.
Anything below this level
cannot be used to treat illness
and may instead damage the Shén.
If the Jiǎ vessel is ill but one treats the Yǐ vessel instead,
this is called "confusion,"
not knowing that the vessel alone is being damaged and severed.
Therefore, if one wishes to know whether the Tiāndào is divine or not,
and whether it corresponds or not,
simply place a sick person before you;
this is called the "original text of the vessels,"
comparable to the original text of the scriptures or the Dào.
Have various worthy people gather around to discuss the illness;
some may excel in upper parts,
some in lower parts;
among the three hundred and sixty vessels,
each can be observed.
Take their practical actions,
and record those methods where they consistently excel and provide healing secrets;
those that succeed ten out of ten times are correct,
and those that do not are all wrong.
Collect these effective practices,
make them into classic books,
and then there will be no illness treated that cannot be resolved.
The Tiāndào regulates the vessels,
whether externally or internally;
they cannot be entirely known.
The places where a treatment succeeds ten out of ten times
are exactly where the vessels meet.
People may be small or large,
and their measurements differ,
but their proportions are the same;
one must always rely on the hollows of the points and the patterns of the skin for them to correspond.
Books on the Dào have accumulated from ancient times to the present,
and what they say differs,
which is called "disordering the vessels."
If the Yáng vessels are not regulated,
but one instead treats the Yīn vessels,
it causes people to suffer blame,
harming good people
and shortening their lives.
The vessels thus correspond with Heaven, Earth, and the myriad things;
they rise with the Qì,
and when their cycle is complete, they return to the beginning.
Therefore, those who obtain their numbers
can use them to nourish their nature
and to know whether the seasonal Qì has arrived or not;
they can stabilize what was originally unregulated.
In ancient times, the sages and worthies
sat in quiet and pure places,
feeling their own pulses,
observing the measures of their movement; by seeing whether they arrived or not,
they could know the gains and losses of the four seasons and the Wǔxíng,
and thereby know the decline or abundance of their own bodies.
This is how to stabilize the state, nourish the body, and preserve the form;
can one not be careful?
If people are deluded and perform moxibustion and acupuncture without proper method,
they damage the correct vessels,
all of which damages the upright Qì
and opposes the four seasons and the Wǔxíng,
causing disasters and anomalies.
Great people are greatly harmed,
and lesser people are harmed less;
all may be disturbed and moved from their proper places;
this is a natural consequence.
For this reason, ancient sages and worthies valued it;
sage emperors and kings remained in their places
and observed the movements of the pulses
to divine the good or bad fortune of the six directions.
This is what is called "knowing the distant from the near"
and "knowing the external from the internal";
therefore, it is the divine and essential Dào.
In Heaven, there are constant divine and sacred essential words,
which are sometimes bestowed upon humans as speech,
causing divine officials to come and go in response to the Qì.
When the people obtain them,
they call them Shénzhù.
When an incantation succeeds a hundred out of a hundred times,
or ten out of ten,
that incantation is the original divine text from Heaven, a transmission of scriptural words.
Such incantations can cause spirits to mysteriously eliminate illness;
if one gathers all those that succeed ten out of ten times,
then wherever they are used, there is nothing that cannot be healed.
To heal illness solely with words
is the work of divine prognostications from Heaven.
Good teachers, emperors, and kings should use them;
they should be collected into scrolls
and thus named Books of Incantations and Prognostications.
This is the means to summon and employ the various spirits;
thus, ten out of ten are healed.
If nine out of ten succeed,
the true spirits have not arrived,
but intermediate spirits have;
this is what high ministers possess.
If eight out of ten succeed,
human spirits have arrived;
this is what those who govern the people possess.
These
are the divine words of Heaven,
originally used to summon spirits;
when names and titles
occasionally leak down to earth,
men of the Dào come to know them
and transmit them to one another in speech;
thus they can treat illness.
If they were just the words of common passersby,
they could not heal illness. Now, changing events
do not wait for man for even a moment.
Heaven values human life,
but fears that extraordinary prescriptions are hard to complete quickly,
or that great physicians might lose the path of the vessels
and not understand the grave matters of life and death;
therefore, it places the essential Dào in the mouths of people;
this is the art of emergency rescue.
If one wishes to obtain these essential words,
