Do you understand?"
"Yes, indeed."
"When wicked writings, wicked words, and erroneous speech are used to govern a state,
it falls into disorder day by day.
Thereupon, the ears are collectively deceived by wicked words, wicked speech, and erroneous writings;
the state thus becomes disordered and endangered;
ministers pervert the law and act recklessly;
and the people are impoverished;
together they defile the order and disorder of Heaven and Earth.
The celestial officials are greatly enraged;
their daily admonitions never cease;
people weep and cry out for justice,
also without ceasing.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"When wicked words, wicked writings, and erroneous speech are used to manage a family,
then fathers and sons, husbands and wives fall into disorder,
hating and loathing one another,
and fighting and arguing constantly without end,
until they become a calamitous family.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, indeed.
How terrifying!
Hearing the words of the Tiān Shī,
I am truly frightened and alarmed.
I, this foolish person, did not consider it deeply
and did not know that such evils could lead to this."
"The Zhēn Rén alone has been foolish for a long time.
Ordinary people regard this as a minor matter and do not eliminate it,
yet they do not know that these wicked words, wicked speech, and wicked writings
are in fact a great grievance against Heaven and Earth;
they are the great thieves of the state
and the fierce ghosts of the common people.
How can they not be cast away all at once and eliminated with great effort?
Therefore, Heaven loves a sovereign of superior virtue,
and fearing that he might not awaken to this
and suffer those great disasters again,
It has therefore sent me down to explain it in detail.
Let the Zhēn Rén quickly convey this in writing,
so as to make him quickly contemplate the intent of Heaven,
whereby he may find peace for himself;
if not,
the wrath of Heaven will surely never end.
Thus, Heaven no longer has the sages speak,
for they would not be able to completely eliminate all these illnesses;
therefore It causes all people under Heaven to share one voice
and together gather the ancient texts to examine them.
Now, Heaven is filled with indignation and accumulated resentment toward these wicked words, wicked writings, biased talk, and isolated sycophantic speech.
Now in examining this,
if the Zhēn Rén wishes to know it,
it is like a sovereign being distressed and enraged by the Yí Dí who repeatedly come to harm the people.
Therefore, he dispatches millions of soldiers to go and attack them;
if there is a failure to be vigorous,
those who are courageous are given many rewards for their merit,
while those who are not courageous are again punished by the sovereign.
The current examination of wicked writings is like this.
Do you understand this, Zhēn Rén?"
"Yes, indeed.
How awe-inspiring!
The world is already being set right."
"It may be said that the Zhēn Rén now knows it!
Now, concerning these isolated speeches,
even the wicked words, wicked writings, and wicked speech of a single person,
Heaven and Earth now regard these as a great grievance;
they are the great thieves of the sovereign.
The stability of the original governance is unsettled,
and everything is thrown into disorder because of this.
Therefore, this must now be cut off,
and all should be made to gather words, gather explanations, and gather memorials to the throne,
to stabilize and settle affairs.
Then the Qì of Heaven will immediately and completely find its proper place,
and wicked words and wicked speech will immediately and completely be cut off,
perishing entirely.
From this day forward, Heaven
will immediately cause people to examine them,
and the spirits will also proceed to examine them;
they will only become more urgent day by day,
with no time of laxity.
Do you understand this, Zhēn Rén?"
"Yes, indeed;
I, this foolish person, am extremely terrified."
"Since you know how to be terrified,
you may avoid being examined along with them."
"Yes, indeed;
I, this foolish person, fall short in every matter
and have heavy punishments and transgressions before Heaven and Earth.
Out of concern for the Tiān Shī’s worries,
I have respectfully seen these warnings against the wicked writings, wicked speech, and the words of a single person;
now I wish to further receive careful and detailed injunctions and warnings,
as to the ultimate warnings regarding where correct writings arrive."
"Excellent!
The written texts already correspond to the words.
Since you yourself ask about it in this manner,
why is that?"
"An ignorant person is stubbornly obtuse;
though my mind aspires to intelligence, I still do not understand.
Without receiving repeated instructions and clear injunctions,
I remain as if in a daze and darkness,
and would again disorder the Tiān Shī’s Dào;
therefore I dare not refrain from asking repeatedly."
"Excellent
are your words.
Very well, sit calmly,
and I shall explain it in detail for the various Zhēn Rén.
Correct words, correct writings, and correct speech
are the roots for correcting Heaven and Earth,
and the precious vessels and parents for stabilizing the state;
they are that from which all ordinary people and the myriad things receive their mandate;
therefore one must strive to correct them."
"Yes, indeed.
I wish to hear how correct words, correct writings, and correct speech are the roots of Heaven and Earth,
the precious vessels of the state,
and the determined meaning of how the common people and myriad things receive their mandate."
"Alas!
The Zhēn Rén has already received these words many times;
within my writings,
I have thoroughly criticized superficiality and wicked words;
yet you ask about it again;
why is that?"
"I was born foolish and follow the common customs;
having been foolish for a long time,
I do not know where wickedness ends;
therefore, unless I receive careful explanations again,
I will not understand at all."
"True.
You wish to know the verified truth of it.
When ordinary people all speak of goodness and strive together to practice it,
yet disasters are not removed at all,
then it is the disorder caused by unkind writings
and unkind words.
Ordinary people might say this is acceptable,
but they cannot achieve goodness;
but if one acts according to them,
and they instead correspond with Heaven,
and disasters are removed day by day,
then those are correct writings, correct words, and correct speech;
internally they alone correspond with Heaven,
and are the clear evidence of obtaining the intent of Heaven and Earth.
For this reason, correct words and correct writings
are what manifest the correct heart of Heaven and Earth.
Therefore, when words are entirely correct,
writings are entirely correct,
speech is entirely correct,
and the sovereign follows and implements them,
reaching down to the common people,
there are none who do not love to practice what is correct.
Heaven and Earth then become greatly corrected;
the four seasons, the five elements, and the myriad things
will all at once each obtain their correctness.
The sun, the moon, and the Three Luminaries will keep their measures,
each obtaining correctness.
The state will be in great peace and without worry,
and it will reach the level of the divine;
the methods for warding off aging will be bestowed,
extraordinary things and auspicious responses will all appear,
and the treacherous, the crafty, the demonic, and the evil will all be extinguished.
Every common person will be able to protect their family
and live out their natural lifespan;
the myriad things will all be able to grow old and reach their end,
each according to its season.
This is how correct words, correct writings, and correct speech are the roots of Heaven and Earth,
the precious vessels and parents of the state,
and the mandate for the people and myriad things;
this is the great and clear proof.
Do you understand this, Zhēn Rén?"
"Yes, indeed.
How terrifying!
How terrifying!
The roots of Heaven and Earth,
the precious vessels of the state,
and our mandate actually reside in this."
"Go on,
it may be said that you are a person who understands affairs
and knows this now.
Therefore Heaven sent me down
to thoroughly examine and correct it.
Since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
those who practice correct words and correct writings,"
Heaven and Earth are always greatly pleased by it,
so it is always good;
as for those who practice evil speech and evil writings,
Heaven and Earth are always in great anger and displeasure because of them,
so it is always ominous and restless,
and there is much danger and ruin.
Common people do not know this is a great illness for Heaven and Earth,
and it disrupts the governance of emperors and kings.
While the lowly and foolish scholars
instead join with crafty artisans
to create essays and records,
practicing evil speech and evil writings
to compete in status with one another,
to deceive their superiors,
and to defile the correct laws of Heaven,
disrupting the correct rituals of Heaven.
This is the great resentment of Heaven
and the great blame of Earth,
and the great thief of the state.
"Now, having gained Heaven's resentment and Earth's blame,
acting as the state's thief,
and daily practicing these things together,
how can order and peace be attained?
Now the Tiānshī rebukes this evil speech and evil writing and punishes these crimes;
how heavy this is!"
"Alas!
Is the Zhēnrén foolish?
People now join together in evil speech and evil writing
to collectively disrupt Heaven and Earth;
Heaven and Earth thus constantly suffer from illness because of them.
Is this not the resentment and blame of Heaven?
It is like when a person constantly acts to harm others;
will people not also resent and blame them?"
"Yes, yes."
"Therefore, the resentment of Heaven and blame of Earth is clear.
Now evil speech, evil writing, and evil rhetoric
have already been used together to deceive superiors
and endanger the state;
such governance always loses the Heart of Heaven.
Their lifespans do not increase,
and for those whose lives are cut short,
it is not just one person who suffers for it;
is this not the great debasement of the state?
Do the Zhēnrén know this or not?"
"Yes, yes."
"People of late antiquity are mostly foolish;
some see the celestial patterns
but conversely speak against them.
If one speaks like this,
they are purely the leader of state thieves,
the great resentment and blame of Heaven and Earth,
a great harm to the people,
and the fierce spectral creatures of the ten thousand things.
A virtuous ruler must be careful not to use their words;
for those who use their words,
Heaven's resentment is not corrected.
One should make deep plans and long-term considerations for oneself,
thinking of the troubles and harms,
to long maintain one's own peace.
Heaven is uniquely generous toward the virtuous ruler;
therefore, it creates for him these works
that can ensure self-security and preserve the state.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go,
you have already attained great awakening.
Be cautious, be cautious;
the majesty of Heaven must not be violated."
"Yes, yes."
"I admonish the Zhēnrén with one word:
from now on,
the virtuous ruler should carefully observe and contemplate the teachings and patterns of Heaven.
For the writings submitted collectively from below by officials and commoners of the Three Ways,
once August arrives, detain and check them,
dividing them into three departments.
The first to check the books should be to the East of the ruler,
for one pass.
Then pass them to be checked to the South of the ruler,
for a second pass.
Then pass them to be checked to the West of the ruler,
for a third pass.
Those who have finished checking should depart to the North of the ruler."
"Those checking are in different places
and must not see each other;
why is this?
I wish to hear of it."
"Indeed, if they see each other, there will be villainy again;
there might be concealment or untruthfulness,
and they would again practice deception like this,
again angering Heaven and Earth as resentment and blame,
becoming the great thieves of the state.
Heaven and Earth hate such people
who cause the rule of emperors and kings to be chaotic.
Therefore, separate their locations
and have three of them check it;
they must collectively verify and investigate it.
This is to appease the Heart of Heaven
and to secure the governance of the King."
"Why must the checking begin to the East of the ruler?"
"The East
is where the Qì of Heaven has a heart and is benevolent.
Those checking the source of matters
should use their hearts in detail
and strive for benevolence to match Heaven and Earth,
while thinking of the desire to secure the Emperor and King;
therefore, it is in the East.
Since the benevolent person acts,
they should observe clearly;
therefore, the work is passed to the Yáng of the ruler.
Once observed clearly,
they should use righteousness to decide and eliminate.
For those with merit, record the merit;
for those without merit, record the lack of merit,
using this as a record of conduct.
Those finished are stored to the North of the ruler,
placed in a dark chamber,
so that the conduct and the good or evil of the people under heaven may be known and not discarded.
Thus, when the virtuous ruler acts accordingly,
he is named a Great Divine Person;
sitting, he knows the hearts of all under heaven
and the movements of every anomaly.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"How awe-inspiring!
How awe-inspiring!"
"Since you know to be in awe of Heaven's discourse,
you shall live long."
"Yes, yes."
"Therefore, from now on,
senior officials will no longer speak of records of conduct;
records of conduct are seen here,
and this is used as the record of conduct.
Thus, the virtuous ruler may sleep peacefully on his pillow
without worry.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Heaven's warning for checking books:
if one matter is omitted,
thirty lashes;
ten matters,
three hundred lashes;
a hundred matters,
three thousand lashes.
The virtuous ruler should dismiss them
and not let them serve again.
This person is negligent in matters;
this is Heaven's resentment and Earth's blame,
the state's great thief.
Resentment, blame, and thieves
cannot be worked with for long,
for they will surely anger Heaven and Earth;
therefore, they must be removed quickly."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"I admonish the Zhēnrén with one great essential:
the way of my writings and texts
descends from above to below
without end.
To all those who love correct speech, correct rhetoric, and correct writing,
I have deeply received Heaven's decree to descend.
Truly knowing that Heaven loves this correct speech and correct writing,
and why it greatly detests this evil speech, evil rhetoric, and evil writing,
knowing clearly the great resentment and blame of Heaven and Earth,
it has thus decreed me
to come down and check,
to remove this resentment, blame, and thieves,
to secure the state that possesses the Way and Virtue,
to long resolve the punishment of inherited burdens since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
to cause all harms to be entirely removed and find rest,
and to allow the correct Qì to entirely come forward and govern.
Then the six directions, the eight distances, and the balanced Qì of August Heaven
will all suddenly arrive of their own accord.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Therefore, my writings
are pure Heaven-speak,
not deviating by even a tiny fraction.
Heaven detests these evil writings,
so I detest them;
Heaven loves these correct writings,
so I love them.
Thus, in my practice of the Way,
I entirely guard the root, caution against the middle, and discard the branch-tips.
Heaven guards the root,
so I guard the root;
Heaven cautions against the middle,
so I caution against the middle;
Heaven discards the branch-tips,
so I discard the branch-tips.
In my creation of writings,
I am of one body, one heart, one intent, one portion, one principle, one liking, one loathing, one way, and one road with Heaven and Earth.
Therefore, I command the virtuous ruler to use them accordingly
without a single error.
For ten thousand times ten thousand years they must not be discarded;
there shall only be daily brilliance
and no times of darkness.
There shall only be daily order
and no times of chaos.
There shall only be daily goodness
and no times of evil.
There shall only be daily auspiciousness
and no times of misfortune.
Therefore, it is called the Correct Way of the Dòngjí of Heaven;
it then embraces the Heart of Heaven and Earth.
Therefore, those who obtain its superior instructions can achieve longevity;
those who obtain its middle instructions become assistants to the state;
and those who obtain its lower instructions
can always keep themselves at peace.
Go now, my words are somewhat finished;
those who have doubts may then come back and ask about them."
"Yes, yes.
May I ask, if there is a single omission or error without cause,
is the punishment exactly thirty lashes?"
"Excellent is your question.
Has Heaven prompted you to speak?
Indeed, as for numbers,
they begin with one
and end with ten.
Thus, to omit or error in one matter
is the very root of the question of the One.
Omissions, errors, and untruths constitute deception,
which then leads to the resentment of Heaven and the blame of Earth;
it is a great thief of the state.
Ten lashes
are to apologize to the Earth.
Ten lashes
are to apologize to the Dìwáng.
Ten each for Heaven, Earth, and Man,
which together make thirty.
One is lashed thus to apologize for the transgression
and to resolve the resentment of Heaven and the blame of Earth,
the thieves of the Dìwáng.
Then Heaven and Earth will be joyful,
and the gods and spirits will cease their trembling anger.
The fundamental reason why Heaven and Earth are often in chaos and trembling anger
is fundamentally due to the examination and verification of documents;
human speech is imprecise and contains many errors,
thus giving rise to this calamity of the inherited burden of Chéngfù.
If things are imprecise again now,
and it continues like this day after day,
then they must be lashed.
It is not because of personal acquaintance,
but rather for the sake of correcting the matter.
Now that a council has gathered
and verified □□,
it is then submitted upward to the right;
gathering further
and verifying □□,
it is then sent downward to the right.
Then it is said that 'above and below both are truthful.'
If only below □□
while the above is not truthful,
it is truly of no benefit.
If only above □□
while the below is not truthful,
it is also of no benefit.
When both above and below are truthful,
then the Heavenly Qì is balanced.
If the below is truthful but the above is not,
the above wrongs the below,
and the below further wrongs itself.
Striving to do good becomes of no benefit,
and the anger of Heaven erupts again.
If the above is truthful but the below is not,
the below wrongs the above,
and the anger of Earth erupts again.
When above and below are both entirely truthful,
if the Dìwáng does not use his mind to govern peacefully,
then the divine officials of the Four Seasons, Five Elements, and Six Relations,
and the Qì of the Liù Zōng,
will lose their harmony and tremble in anger,
and malevolent Qì will erupt again.
Even if one strived to have the three paths carry out documents
and corrected the speech and writings of the world,
if one does not personally strive to balance them,
there is no benefit.
Therefore, I have received the Heavenly Heart
to create transformation for the Shànghuáng Déjūn.
I dare not lose the Heavenly Heart.
Therefore, I strictly follow Heavenly Law,
taking the images of Heaven and Earth as the standard,
following Yáng as the correct path,
and obeying the Four Seasons and Five Elements as commands.
This shall not change for ten thousand generations.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
I, your humble student, have respectfully awakened to this,
and I greatly fear the Heavenly Law."
"Since you know to fear it,
you are already increasingly auspicious.
I will caution the Zhēnrén with a great essential word.
As for the method of examining and comparing documents,
do not merely say that the divine text is like the written text
and say that this makes it true;
this is called 'deaf writing.'
Does the spoken matter alone lack a root or handle?
How can one speak like this?
Do not prohibit its existence,
but simply ask for the meaning of the words.
When the meaning is obtained,
then the matter can be clarified.
If its meaning is not explained,
how can one possibly know it?
Therefore, one should ask for its resolving meaning;
otherwise,
it cannot be used.
This is called 'deaf governance.'
If you wish to joyfully know its meaning,
it is like human speech which must have a root.
There must be a source from which it arises;
one cannot merely say 'Dōng Gōng said so' to establish a matter.
For when people provide evidence to establish a matter, all have a root;
how could one just falsely set up empty words?
Therefore, for all matters,
all should be based on their actual reality
and then the matter can be established.
If you wish to know its great effects and clear proofs,
it is like the transformative method I create for the Déjūn,
all of which are tested to establish a response.
These are words of efficacy.
If they are practiced but there is no response,
then they are false words.
If they are practiced but there is no response,
then it is against Heaven.
As for explaining texts and speech truthfully,
it is like this.
How can one emptily establish a proof and speak,
with the text and speech having no explanation?
Foolish people might conversely be restricted,
asking why each divine text and speech is like this;
these are merely words to resolve difficulties and repel destitution.
How majestic is the divine text!
Perhaps it has a unique meaning,
but if one only transmits its words,
it does not reside in a single scroll.
If it is transmitted alone
and explained from afar,
people will not deeply grasp the meaning of its instructions,
and will conversely only use it to repel difficulties and save themselves from destitution,
saying 'Dōng Jiǔ said...',
trying to clarify themselves by this.
But this is not the truth.
All of them lose the intended meaning of the explanation.
What causes the words of Dàodé to not be understood
is entirely because of this.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, yes.
I, your humble student, have respectfully awakened to this."
"Indeed, if you were like this and did not awaken,
then you would be lost.
Therefore, examine my book,
and those who investigate texts and human speech
should all thoroughly ask for the meaning.
How one obtains the explanation
is by grouping things according to their categories.
Then, subsequently, the texts and speech of the world
will have their words thoroughly clarified,
the laws of the Heavenly Way can be seen,
and the words of good and evil will be understood."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Go now,
my Way is seen in this.
Let the Zhēnrén contemplate it from above and below, over and over;
everything will further prove and clarify one another,
and then there will be nothing left uninterpreted.
The affairs of the world
will all be completed.
The Dàdào will be attained,
Heaven and Earth will be joyful,
and the Déjūn will be forever at peace.
The whole world with one voice
will all say, 'Excellent!'
No longer will there be talk of celestial governance,
and the intentions of the hearts of Heaven and Earth will be regained;
therefore, it is called 'peace.'
Carrying out affairs will gain the hearts of ordinary people,
so the world will no longer have critical words.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
if there are slight differences in wording or doubts,
come back and ask."
"Yes, yes."
Above is the text of the Dòngjí Jīng regarding the signs of the harm to the nation from the resentment of Heaven and the blame of Earth.
"May I ask why the three lights of heaven
are eclipsed from time to time?"
"Excellent
is your question!
This is the great wrath of Heaven and Earth;
Heaven and Earth are in conflict and disharmony,
and the verification of this is manifested in the sun, moon, and stars.
Thus, they may be eclipsed,
or they may not be eclipsed;
the fault lies in the conflict between the *Yīn* and *Yáng* energies. "
"Why do they conflict?"
"*Yīn* and *Yáng* encroach upon each other,
contending for victory or defeat in turn.
Now, *Yīn* and *Yáng*
should originally benefit and assist one another
to jointly create harmonious energy,
but instead they conflict;
the fault lies entirely in this lack of harmony and adjustment. "
"If they were harmonized and adjusted so that no eclipse occurs,
would they then indeed not be eclipsed?"
"Indeed.
In the most excellent times of the *Dàdòng* in high antiquity,
they were never eclipsed.
Later generations became increasingly numerous,
and together they lost the intent of Heaven and Earth,
eventually causing *Yīn* and *Yáng* to gradually lose their mutual love,
thus leading to conflict.
You may think my words are not so.
But if you have a virtuous ruler examine and practice my writings
and he fully grasps their intent,
the conflict will cease;
if he grasps a small part of the intent,
it will cease a little;
if he grasps half of the intent,
it will cease by half.
If he does not practice them diligently,
he will certainly remain in distress. "
"May I ask:
As for the eclipses of the sun and moon,
at what stage of the temporal cycles do they encounter each other?"
"Alas!
How foolish you are!
The *Zhēnrén* would only further provoke the wrath of Heaven.
How can the *Zhēnrén* today know what constitutes the temporal cycles?"
"This humble student sees them occupying the same place. "
"How dark and obscure
is your mind!
How severe is its darkness!
If it were truly as you say,
that it is a matter of cycles encountering each other,
then why would the sun and moon be eclipsed within a single year?
There would be no explanation.
Or why would they not be eclipsed for consecutive years?
How could the cycles be so?
When emperors and kings practice the *Dào* and *Dé* extensively,
the sun and moon are not eclipsed because of it,
and the stars do not disorder their movements.
Why is this so?
Furthermore, by the nature of Heaven,
*Yīn* and *Yáng* occupy the same place
and should originally love each other;
why instead do they harm each other?
Moreover, *Yīn* and *Yáng* should originally generate each other in turn
and complete each other's achievements in turn;
why instead do they plunder and harm each other?"
"This is your foolishness.
If you wish to know the reality of it,
it is comparable to human beings.
When people usually treat each other with kindness,
even if they have not seen each other for a long time,
once they happen to meet,
they are greatly delighted
and then proceed to assist and benefit each other,
praising and illuminating one another;
but when they are usually not in accord with one another,
when they suddenly meet, they immediately fight.
If the discord is great,
they fight until death;
if the discord is small,
they have a small fight. "
"How astonishing!
How astonishing!
This humble student has understood.
May I ask:
Now the sun is the *Tàiyáng*,
the essence of fire;
the moon is the *Tàiyīn*,
the essence of water.
Now water and fire do not occupy the same place,
and if they encounter each other, they destroy each other.
What is the meaning of this?
Is it because they are not in accord?"
"Excellent!
Your words have grasped the meaning.
Yet when water and fire each follow their own *Dào*
and maintain their proper conduct,
they both harmonize with each other,
and thus establish merit and accomplish tasks.
It is comparable to the *Wǔxíng*:
none can be dispensed with,
and they all generate and complete each other in turn.
If you wish to know the reality of it,
it is comparable to the *Wǔzàng*
residing within a person's abdomen,
occupying the same place.
The heart is fire
and the kidneys are water;
how could it be that because they are in the same place,
they would daily fight and eclipse each other?
Do you understand this now?"
"Yes, yes.
This humble student has awakened to it. "
"Therefore, when the energy of peace and harmony arrives,
the three lights no longer fight or eclipse each other.
Only after the three lights do not eclipse each other
can one begin to say that the Heart of Heaven and Earth has been attained;
let this be the proof.
Therefore, if one wishes to know their own superiority or inferiority
and practices the *Dào* and *Dé*,
yet has not fully observed this heavenly proof,
but merely collects various writings
that say occupying the same place causes eclipses—
such a person merely records writings about mutual love
without having deeply grasped their meaning.
Even if there are divine writings saying so,
Heaven has not yet deeply revealed the true situation.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes. "
"Well then,
you have awakened.
After my writings are issued,
if emperors, kings, and virtuous rulers reflect on this intent of Heaven
and do not forget these words—
these words are the text by which the Heart of Heaven is attained.
If the intent of Heaven is attained,
one's life mandate will be long and complete;
if the intent of Heaven is not attained,
it throws the gate of life into disorder;
if one's actions do not match the Heart of Heaven,
it is also a great calamity.
From the beginning of high antiquity,
the various sagely emperors and kings took this as a warning.
Remember my words deeply
and bind them to your heart;
then the subtle words can be seen
and the *Dào* can be attained.
Entrust this to a ruler of superior virtue
to save the three lights from their conflicts and eclipses. "
"Yes, yes. "
"You may go now;
the discourse is somewhat finished.
If you have doubts, come and ask again. "
"Yes, yes. "
"I ask: since the world shares the sun and the moon,
and shares the Dipper and the Pole Star,
a single large division contains twelve thousand states.
The middle division has eighty-one domains,
which are divided into small divisions,
each being one state.
Those whose virtue is superior extend over twelve thousand lǐ of land;
the next extend over ten thousand lǐ in breadth and length;
the next nine thousand lǐ;
the next eight thousand lǐ;
the next seven thousand lǐ;
the next six thousand lǐ;
the next five thousand lǐ;
the next four thousand lǐ;
the next three thousand lǐ;
the next two thousand lǐ;
the next one thousand lǐ;
the next five hundred lǐ;
and the next one hundred lǐ.
These are the level lands
where those of superior or inferior virtue establish and preserve themselves.
As for those of inferior virtue,
they may not have even a single piece of level land,
and all their territory suffers disasters and transformations,
causing the sun and moon of that single state to be eclipsed.
Among the twelve thousand states,
will they all suffer eclipse?
If the Dipper and the Pole Star are not bright,
will all twelve thousand states likewise be not bright?"
"Excellent!
How deep, how far-reaching, how subtle!
This is what you ask.
Why do you specifically ask about these current strange changes and anomalies?
If there is a change in one state,
why should the twelve thousand states share in its reputation,
and why should there be changes elsewhere as well?"
"I find it strange,
and if I do not ask the Tiān Shī,
I fear I will never know the reason even after ages have passed;
therefore, I ask it."
"Excellent!
That which you doubt
may be said to be an entry into the Dào.
When there is a change in one state,
the sun is dim in that one state alone;
this is called an eclipse.
Neighboring states
may also observe it from afar,
but the states in the four distant directions
naturally do not experience the eclipse.
If the stars of the Dipper and the Pole are not bright,
only those who have lost the intent of Heaven are not bright,
while those in the four distant directions naturally do not suffer eclipse."
"Now I ask: by what obstacle or concealment are they alone made not bright?"
"Alas!
You are indeed as ignorant as an uninstructed child,
like a common person.
Now, Heaven and Earth
are separated by a vast distance.
In a state that has lost the Dào and lacks virtue,
evil qi from below rises together to obscure and conceal Heaven.
The three lights each travel upward according to their kind,
but this causes them to be not bright.
It is like being in a place of mist;
the three lights alone are not bright there,
while in a place without mist,
they are naturally very bright.
If you wish to understand this further:
in a shaded place, one alone does not see the lunar eclipse;
in a sunny place, one alone sees the solar eclipse.
If you wish to understand its truth further:
for instance, if this year the Tài Suì is in Zǐ,
a virtuous state alone has a prosperous year,
while a state without virtue alone has a disastrous year.
Now, though both share one country and one period,
sharing the same year,
their fortune and misfortune differ.
Just as people share the same Heaven and Earth,
their places of safety and danger
are different and not the same.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
Excellent, excellent!"
"Now, the sun and moon revolve and shine,
and the twelve thousand states share them,
yet the places where they are bright or not bright differ.
In a state that possesses Dào Dé,
its governance is pure and clear,
tranquil and without evil;
therefore, its three lights alone are greatly bright,
for the evil and Yin qi from below cannot rise to obscure them.
When they are not bright,
the fault lies below in collectively deceiving the superior;
evil qi rises together
and obscures what is above.
In a state without the Dào,
its governance is turbid and corrupt,
with much wickedness and self-concealment,
and therefore its three lights are not bright.
If you wish to understand its truth further:
compare it to squinting to look at the sun
versus opening the eyes wide to look at the sun;
compare it to opening the eyes well to look at the sun
versus looking at the sun through a thin silk cloth.
It is precisely like this.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes,
how startling!
How startling!"
"If you know to be startled by this,
then you shall obtain long life."
"Yes, yes."
"In a state about to suffer disaster and decline,
the three lights are all not bright.
It is like a blind person
who alone does not see the brightness of the three lights;
the three lights remain as they are,
but because the person is blind,
he alone does not see them.
It is like those in their prime
who alone see the brightness of the three lights,
while the elderly alone do not see the brightness of the three lights;
this is the effect of flourishing and decline.
Do you understand it all?"
"Yes, yes.
I shall go now.
I ask: what does the teaching of the 'One Absolute Decision' explain?
If I do not clearly know the 'One',
what is it?"
"Alas!
The Zhēn Rén has guarded the texts for so long;
why is he confused by this?
Now you are dazed and dim.
If you know how to guard the One,
the ten thousand matters are completed.
Why do you ask such a subtle thing?
You should reflect on these words."
"Yes, yes."
"The One
is the heart,
the mind,
and the will.
It is the thought of the spirit within this single body.
All matters in the world
are entirely accomplished by this.
From ancient times until now,
the transformations of worthies and sages
have all used this to perfect their vessels and reputations,
because they knew it early,
studied their heart and mind,
directed their will and thoughts toward the good,
and guarded good deeds.
The foolish are entirely disastrous because of this,
because they guard and learn from evil deeds.
The nature of Heaven and Earth
and of all crawling creatures is like this.
Therefore, by learning this from a master,
longevity can be attained;
whatever Dào one learns,
Heaven and Earth can be regulated.
To gather millions of people
is not as good as serving one worthy person.
Millions of foolish people
can only lead to swift disaster and ruin.
If one can truly guard the person of one worthy,
what harm can there be for one who possesses a body?
If one cannot reflect back upon oneself as in a mirror,
let the thoughts return and once again mirror the body.
If the will and thoughts are far away, the body becomes ill,
withering and falling into neglect;
if the will and thoughts are near, the body will have luster.
The things accomplished by the will and thoughts are numerous;
though they are not recorded in advance,
the matters of the world are all like this.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
I ask: when drought and frost cause all to die,
and the people suffer from hunger and cold,
dying from the severity—
what is it that kills them?"
"This
is the killing by the Tài Yáng of August Heaven.
When the six Yang are all resentful,
they are then able to cause harm."
"What does this mean?
I wish to hear of it."
"Indeed,
the six directions and the ultimate void
contain great hardness within.
They all resent that humans have long committed disorder and evil,
and therefore they kill.
What is their harm to humans?
It has no name.
But when one encounters the extremity of Chéng Fù,
the anger of Heaven erupts;
it does not distinguish between a person's good or evil.
Those who encounter it
will suffer great misfortune.
If you wish to know its reality,
it is like a person."
When people are greatly indignant and angry,
they are angry at Jiǎ, who is a good person;
yet they do not avoid him,
but instead harm Yǐ, Bǐng, and Dīng.
Now, what fault do Yǐ, Bǐng, and Dīng have?
Yet they encounter the outburst of human anger;
the outburst of Heaven's anger is also like this.
Therefore, the responsibility of Chéngfù is most severe;
thus it causes people to die,
no longer distinguishing between good and evil.
The great calamity lies in this.
Therefore, my writings respond to the teachings of Heaven,
intending now to completely cut off the responsibility of Chéngfù.
Heaven's errors are deep and heavy;
it harms many innocent people,
and Heaven is deeply concerned about this.
Therefore, it instructs me to command the Zhēnrén
to entrust these writings to a ruler of supreme virtue,
ordering that evil, sycophantic, and hypocritical people be eliminated,
so that the principles of the Way of Heaven may be ordered.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, yes.
I wish to ask, since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
some people die completely of severe diseases,
some die completely by floods,
or some die completely by weapons;
I wish to hear the meaning of this:
what crimes have they committed to be thus convicted?
Is it entirely due to the conjunctions of Heaven and Earth?
Or is it the disaster of Chéngfù?"
"Indeed.
The texts of ancient and modern times
mostly say these are the conjunctions of the Yīn and Yáng of Heaven and Earth;
this is not so.
These are all the disasters of Chéngfù.
When the celestial qi and the Zhōnghé qi are angry,
and the divine spirits do battle,
those who die of severe diseases
are those whom Heaven strikes and removes;
those who die by floods
are those whom Earth strikes and removes;
those who die by weapons
are those whom humans strike and remove."
"I wish to hear, concerning those who die of severe diseases,
for what reason are they killed by Heaven?"
"Heaven
is the master of spirits and the leader of divine beings;
therefore, it causes essential spirits and ghosts to kill people.
Earth
is the lowly of the Yīn.
Water
is the extreme of the Yīn
and belongs to Earth.
The Yīn governs pregnancy.
Whenever a creature is pregnant and harmed,
it must result in blood.
Blood
is of the same category as water.
One who is pregnant and harmed
will surely be angry and displeased,
and further use its blood to pollute and harm others.
Water
is the blood vessels of Earth,
the Yīn of Earth.
The Yīn is lowly;
when it is angry, it must use its own body to engage in battle and kill people.
It is like a subject going to capture a thief:
he must use his own body to go and seize him.
He cannot be like a lord,
who merely stays in his place and speaks.
Zhōnghé is governed by humans;
the Four Seasons and Five Elements govern it together,
and humans should harmonize and enact them.
When humans lose the Way and cannot be compliant,
they become indignant.
Therefore, the qi of the Four Seasons becomes rebellious,
the Five Elements do battle,
and thus they cause humans to attack one another.
These things
are all because the Zhōnghé of Heaven and Earth
is indignant and displeased,
accumulating for a long time until there is sickness and melancholy;
hence this is brought about."
"Excellent!
Had I not questioned with effort just now,
there would be no way to know this.
I wish to hear: if all these are disasters of Chéngfù
resulting from the indignation of the three qi,
then in times when there is no Chéngfù,
how do people die?"
"Indeed.
Human life has an end;
the high, the low, and the middle each complete their natural lifespan.
Some may attain the True Way
and thus can transcend the world and depart;
these people are without the fault of Chéngfù.
This is the art of nature.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Very well,
understand this!
Those who die following one another all at once
do not die according to their fate.
This is the effect of the battle and anger of the Zhōnghé of Heaven and Earth and the Four Seasons and Five Elements, which ambush and kill them."
"Excellent, excellent!
Had I not just asked the Tiānshī,
there would be no way to know this."
"Therefore, since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
this disaster has always existed,
but people have all been unable to know it.
Now, being very distressed and worried about it,
as many people die without guilt,
it has moved Heaven above.
Heaven therefore sent me down
to speak of it in detail for them.
After my celestial writings are implemented,
the people and the ten thousand things shall each die according to their own lifespan,
and there will no longer be occasions of collective death."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Future generations shall each obtain their fate.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes.
I ask: if they do not die when the Way of Heaven and the cycles of time have completed,
why is it that they are always thrown into chaos by the conjunctions of Heaven and Earth?
Why do the Five Elements battle at their conjunctions?
Is it because the divine cycles of the Wǔdì have ended and are exhausted?"
"Ah,
excellent!
The Zhēnrén's difficult question.
Is it Heaven that has made you ask this now?
The words you offer enter into the prophecy of Heaven's heart.
What a singular essential secret!
I am very pleased by it.
Now, it is truly as you say;
now I shall explain it for you in detail.
Now that all you Zhēnrén have come from afar
to ask about matters concerning Heaven and Earth in detail,
asking about the doubts of emperors and kings since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
you should sit peacefully and listen to my words."
"Yes, yes."
"Indeed, the laws enacted by Heaven
and the fates of the people and the ten thousand things
are like the qi of the Four Seasons,
which should only generate one another in turn,
passing along and departing.
It is like human life;
the young will later become old and grown,
successively passing along and departing.
It should not be that the Way engages in battle,
thereby exterminating the species of the world.
The reason why the Way battles and people die completely of floods, droughts, and pestilence
is that the rulers, following what their predecessor kings and ancestors uniquely accumulated,
gradually lost the intent of the Way.
This accumulated for a long time until reaching this conjunction;
if they do not then save themselves,
they are consequently exterminated completely,
and once exterminated, no types remain.
Now, the Three Systems of Heaven, Earth, and Humanity
stand by needing one another
and are formed by shaping one another.
It is like a person having a head, feet, belly, and body.
If one system is disastrously destroyed,
the three systems conversely all fall into ruin.
If a person has no head, feet, or belly,
and even one is missing,
then all three are in disaster.
Therefore, when the Great Way of humans greatly ruins Heaven and Earth,
the Three Systems go to ruin,
turning into darkness and confusion,
and the ten thousand things consequently perish.
Now, when things are exhausted,
they cannot be born suddenly again.
Because of this, how much is lost,
and how much is exterminated?
When they arise again, some may recover immediately,
while some suffer great ruin for a long time
and only after a long time can they recover;
therefore, minor ruin allows for quick recovery.
You wish to further know the investigated truth of this,
to let the virtuous rulers of future generations examine it clearly,
and know the great effects of the grievances of Heaven and Earth.
It is like a family managing their livelihood;
those who have many reserves,
even if they happen to encounter a bad year of Chéngfù with no harvest,
they will remain firm and preserve themselves.
Families with very large reserves,
even if they suffer bad years for several years in a row,
can still usually survive.
Families with small reserves,
if they encounter successive years without harvest,
will all starve to death.
Families that are always poor,
if they encounter one year of disaster,
will all die.
They cannot save themselves or escape;
they are distressed and leave no descendants.
The Way of Heaven has standards and laws;
the cycle is not merely a conjunction.
It is like how in summer and autumn one should work hard to harvest,
and in winter and spring one should sit and eat the completed work;
If one does not work hard to harvest in summer and autumn,
one will surely starve to death and be wiped out in winter and spring.
The Heavenly Books of the Shèngrén of antiquity
recorded these as critical conjunctions because of this.
If the Zhēnrén wishes to know it, it is like this.
Now that the Qì of Tàipíng has arrived,
things should be constantly peaceful,
and one should no longer speak of death and destruction at these conjunctions.
Heaven mandates the Dìwáng to rule,
thus enlightening the Déjūn.
When the common people serve its Dào,
the essential point is to make them realize and understand this at a single glance.
If the elders and common people had always upheld the essential Dào and essential Dé,
even if they encountered a conjunction,
they would not die.
Heaven's method for the Dìwáng to rule the state
regards having Dào and Dé as great wealth,
and lacking Dào and Dé as great poverty and distress.
Those known as having no Dào and no Dé
are feared to be unable to pacify Heaven and Earth and will thus lose them.
The elders gradually and collectively abandoned Dào and Dé;
this accumulated for a long, long time,
until it resulted in mutual chéngfù,
and later generations suffered its grievous poisons and severe disasters,
all corresponding to a rule without the Dào.
When it reaches the point where the cycles and conjunctions bring extermination,
and they cannot extract themselves,
the great fault lies here.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
How terrifying!
How terrifying!"
"Let me further enlighten the Zhēnrén with another word.
Dào and Dé in relation to humans
are truly the heart of Heaven.
It is comparable to a person having a heart;
if the human heart is good and upholds the Dào,
then it is always granted good fortune.
If the human heart is evil and does not uphold the Dào,
then it is always in decline and misfortune.
If the spirit of the heart leaves,
then one dies.
Therefore, when the essential Dào and Dé are severed,
humans die,
and Heaven and Earth are also disordered and destroyed.
Thus, the Dào makes Heaven, Earth, and Man share the same concerns and tasks from the start,
so they can mutually generate one another.
If they do not share the same concerns and tasks,
they will be unwilling to mutually generate one another
or care for and benefit one another.
Therefore, Dào and Dé link them and give them a shared destiny.
For this reason, when Heaven and Earth see that humans have Dào and Dé and perform good deeds,
they are greatly pleased.
When they see humans doing evil,
they are greatly enraged and indignant.
Does the Zhēnrén understand?"
"Yes, yes.
How terrifying!
Your humble student greatly fears this."
"If you know to fear it,
then you can live long without misfortune.
If you do not know to fear it,
then Heaven has already moved to remove you;
you should be doubly cautious."
"Yes, yes."
"Let me further enlighten the Zhēnrén with another explanation.
Now, the progression of good and bad fortune
is comparable to Dào, Dé, Lǐ, and Yì versus punishments.
If humans uphold Dào, Dé, Lǐ, and Yì,
then punishments do not arise.
If they lose Dào, Dé, Lǐ, and Yì,
then punishments arise.
Therefore, for those who uphold the good Dào,
the path to misfortune is naturally cut off;
it departs of its own accord without being told to go.
For those who uphold the path of misfortune,
the path of speech is naturally cut off.
This is like the sun rising and the stars fleeing,
or the stars appearing and the sun setting,
without missing by the smallest fraction."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Now I shall enlighten the Zhēnrén with a great secret word.
People of the present age have accumulated extreme foolishness and ignorance;
they pass on stories to one another,
saying that the cycles of time naturally have good and bad fortune.
According to such words,
what benefit would there be in doing good?
What harm would there be in doing evil?
If it is simply the natural cycles of time,
why work hard to do good?
What merit would there be?
Yet, fortunate ones and Shèngrén always receive the heart of Heaven
and teach people to do good;
this is correct.
To speak of 'cycles of time'
and instead collectively disorder the Heavenly Dào
are words
that make Heaven and Earth constantly displeased.
In reality, it is human actions that bring this about,
yet they perversely say the cycles of Heaven's time are naturally evil.
They are unwilling to say they themselves are evil,
but instead imply that Heaven and Earth are evil.
This is like the unfilial and wicked son of a family
who is unwilling to say he is evil
but instead says his parents are evil;
this is what it means.
Therefore, Heaven is constantly distressed, indignant, and sorrowful.
Because of these conjunctions,
Heaven kills them and makes them fight,
delighting in changing their generation and kind.
Formerly, they should not have just followed one another;
the old depart,
the young grow,
each exhausting their transformations according to their lifespan,
just as since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
human forms have changed and differed."
"Excellent!
Your humble student has gained a great understanding from this;
although the human form differs between ancient and modern times, the Qì is the same."
"If you wish to further know the truth of it,
it is like the Qì of the four seasons
and the positions of the Wǔxíng;
although they do not receive the same things,
internally they share the same Qì and turn to generate one another.
It is also like a person's head and feet being dissimilar,
yet internally they combine to form one person."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Now I shall again enlighten the Zhēnrén with another word.
Heaven has accumulated illness
because humans do evil,
yet they perversely and constantly say the cycles of time are unlucky.
When the Qì of Shànghuáng arrives,
it should assist the Déjūn in governing.
I fear the people of the time will not change their actions
and will perform evil deeds to disorder the correct Qì
and destroy Heaven's treasures.
Therefore, I have been sent down
to produce texts for the Déjūn,
in order to enlighten the masses,
so they may collectively and constantly act according to my texts,
no longer collectively grieving Heaven and Earth and not violating Heaven's prohibitions.
From now on,
if they carry out my Heavenly Texts,
they will cause the spirits to assist the Déjūn in governing.
Those who violate them shall be executed;
if humans do not execute them,
the spirits will execute them.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes,
I would not dare to violate them."
"Fine.
The words are slightly concluded.
Reflect on the essentials of all the writings yourself."
"Yes, yes.
May I ask the Tiānshī,
the talismans and strategies of the twelve thousand nations each have different meanings;
where should they all be placed?
Each follows its national customs,
but what should be the starting point?"
"It starts from where the fire Qì arises in the southeast of the Dǒují.
I wish to hear the secret meaning of it.
Why is this?"
"Fire
is Yáng.
Its talisman now governs the heart of Heaven.
Harmony governs bestowal,
opening governs passage,
and brightness governs the management of all affairs.
Fire is the heart;
the heart governs the spirit.
Harmony can be the head of transformation.
When the myriad things are about to rise,
they start from the heart.
The heart governs correct affairs,
relies on Rén to be bright,
and furthermore possesses divine light.
When the diverse strategies of the twelve thousand nations are unified,
and used as documents and memorials to the throne,
the Heavenly Qì will naturally follow and circulate.
Let the Zhēnrén encourage himself and raise it up.
Do not go against it.
If you die,
it is because Heaven delighted in producing the texts,
and thus caused me to speak.
If you do not believe my words,
seek the proof in your own body.
If you carry them out, disasters will be eliminated daily;
this is because Heaven delights in their practice.
Therefore, disasters are eliminated.
If you do not carry them out and there is much illness and disaster,
this is Heaven being indignant and sorrowful,
because you are obstructing its Dào.
Do not ask others about fire or misfortune;
take your proof from this,
as clear as the sun and moon.
What the Heavenly Will desires to do,
you must be cautious of.
If you do not act or do not follow,
it will cause the hearts of people to be disordered.
Let the Zhēnrén be cautious of it."
"Certainly, certainly."
"Go,
and I will again caution the Zhēnrén with one word.
What Heaven does not wish to carry out,
should you alone carry it out,
it will only bring distress.
My writings use this as evidence;
from now on,
it shall all be thus.
The writings have already become repetitive;
I will not speak further to add to them,
lest it make the Dào difficult to understand."
"Certainly, certainly."
"Go,
and I will again caution you with one word:
these disasters and illnesses
are not the fault of the people of a single generation;
their origins are remote and ancient.
Do not, conversely, suddenly cause harm.
You should only practice the Tiāndào
in order to eliminate them.
One who acts in this way
is said to have attained the intent of Heaven's heart.
If one does not follow the words of my writings
and instead unjustly hastens punishments,
disasters will increase daily,
and Heaven will not be pleased.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Certainly, certainly."
"I ask: In antiquity, when the phase of fire
likewise corresponded to Tàipíng,
yet the Shéndào was not corrected,
why does the Tiānshī now exclusively command the phase of fire to correct the Shéndào?
Why is this?"
"Excellent!
Your question is excellent.
For this reason, a hundred people have a hundred ideas,
a thousand people have a thousand ideas,
ten thousand people have ten thousand ideas;
the strategies they employ are all different and distinct;
thus, most do not attain the intent of Heaven's heart.
What the Zhēnrén says is correct.
Now the qi of fire is at its peak;
the qi of the Shànghuáng has arrived,
and it is truly extraordinary.
In antiquity, when the phase of fire
followed the qi of Tàipíng,
since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
there has never been anything like this."
"When the qi of fire is flourishing,
the Shéndào must be corrected.
Why is this?
I wish to hear the reason."
"Indeed.
Fire
is the heart of Heaven.
The heart governs the spirits;
when the heart is correct, then the spirits will be bright.
Therefore, Heaven has sent me down to regulate the Shéndào."
"Since the Shéndào is already divine in itself,
why must it be regulated?"
"Excellent
are your words.
Spirits
are the correct officials of Heaven.
Now, evil spirits are many,
so the correct spirits cannot find their place.
Within the Shéndào of Heaven, there is great chaos,
and all have lost their dwellings.
Now the qi of Heaven is out of harmony;
sovereigns are distressed by it,
and people do not know the essential meaning of it.
You wish to joyfully know its [lacuna],
and this may be compared to human affairs.
Now, many evil people occupy positions,
together throwing the sovereign's governance into chaos.
Now this causes upright people to not find their place,
and Heaven and Earth lose their correctness because of their evil qi.
When evil is abundant, it together harms the upright;
when the upright are abundant, they together prohibit and stop evil.
These two things
are the natural methods of Heaven and Earth.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?
Therefore, the Tàiyáng is made to be at its peak;
there has never been anything like it.
That which is Yáng is called divine,
therefore Heaven is divine.
That which is Yīn is called evil,
therefore treacherous qi always comes and goes within the Yīn,
not daring to travel in the full light of day.
If the treacherous travel in the full light of day,
it is called 'Yīn usurping the path of Yáng';
if illness manifests during the day,
it is called 'Yīn flourishing and rising';
this is because Yáng has lost its Dào.
The decline of the ruler has allowed this for a long time.
Therefore, the Tiāndào has me correct the Shéndào,
causing them to not dare act thus again.
Do you know this?"
"Certainly, certainly.
Excellent, excellent!"
"May I ask about the Dòngjí Shàngpíng Qì, which treats all things without exception,
so that the Tiānshī examines the sores, scabies, and pests that consume humans?
Is this the only evidence used now?
What about the other pests?"
"Excellent!
The Zhēnrén asks about this matter this morning.
Does the haste of Heaven cause you to ask this?
Heaven intensely hates people doing evil;
slippery officials and commoners who turn their backs on Heaven and oppose the Earth,
together deceiving their superiors.
Wickedness that has long accumulated in Yin-like concealment
is like pests consuming humans;
Heaven detests this venomously.
Thus, it causes you to ask about it repeatedly.
Yet when pests consume humans,
it is what is called 'pests governing humans.'
Its disaster is most severe,
a case of rebellious qi disrupting the upright.
Now that the Imperial Píng Qì has arrived,
there should not be such a response.
The Zhēnrén is entrusted to the Dé Jūn,
wishing to know how the Way permeates all;
why have the common people not yet completely moved the names of the pest-lords,
categorized by the harm they do, large or small?
Regarding sores, leprosy, wounds, and scabies,
they all come from the category of the Sān Chóng in the belly;
all their primary names should be moved.
For those whose movement is great and numerous,
it is certainly because many pests below are governing people.
Where these pests are absent,
there are no pests below governing people.
Where they are few,
fewer pests govern people."
"Excellent!

"Ah!

Good heavens!
How startling.
Good heavens!

"This humble student received the instructions and commands of the Celestial Master (Tiān Shī),

"Excellent!
Your words.

"Indeed.

"Excellent!
Your words.

"Yes."
"Now I shall distinguish and explain it in detail for the Perfected One (Zhēn Rén),

"Yes, yes."
"Go on.
Heavenly numbers fundamentally begin with one
and end at ten.
One multiplied by ten
is ten.
Each multiplied by ten reaches a hundred,
a hundred multiplied by ten reaches a thousand,
a thousand multiplied by ten reaches ten thousand.
One
is the beginning of the numbers.
Ten
is the end of the numbers.
A hundred
is the region of virtuous nations.
You just take my books
and go to transmit the teachings to that one nation of great virtue.

"Excellent, excellent!

"Excellent, excellent!

"Excellent!
Your questioning
has grasped the point.
Indeed, as for the numbers of Heaven, Earth, and Man,

Heaven bestows its gifts upon the Earth to bring life;
once the numbers are complete, it then emerges,

Heaven, Earth, and Man are fully prepared;
when Heaven, Earth, and Man, these three, unite with one heart,

"I wish to hear why the heavenly numbers are exactly one?"
"One
is the time when the Primordial Qi (Yuán Qì) is pure.
The Primordial Qi (Yuán Qì) combines without distinct patterns,
like the wind without distinct patterns;
therefore, collectively it is named 'One'.
The One condenses to form Heaven.
Heaven has above and below and the eight directions;
therefore it is ten.
There are also the five directions,
each having its own Yīn and Yáng;
therefore the count is ten.
Below, it follows the Earth;
that 'One' following the Earth
is born when the numbers are gathered at ten.
Therefore, man models himself on heavenly numbers,
being born after ten months.
One
is exactly the time of the vast and deep bestowal of harmony.
Having bestowed love,
it must in return model itself on heavenly numbers,
emerging after ten months;
therefore, the count ends at ten.
Thus, one is multiplied by ten.
The Way of Earth (Dì Dào)
is the mother;
she should be the partner,

When Heaven, Earth, and Man, these three, obtain each other, then the Way (Dào) and Virtue (Dé) are achieved;
therefore there are exactly a hundred virtuous nations.
Thus, Heaven presides over birth,
and Earth presides over nourishment."
The ruler of men achieves success.
If one matter loses its correctness,
all three together become deviant.
Therefore, if Heaven commits evil, it is also a calamity;
if Earth commits evil, it is also a calamity;
if humanity commits evil, it is also a calamity.
If all three together commit evil,

if all three together commit good,
their virtue will permeate the void and unite as one.
Thus, when the three combine to form virtue,
it will be suitable for the hundred nations."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"This

"Yes, indeed."
"Therefore, now that the Zhēnrén has removed the ailments of Heaven and Earth

"Excellent, excellent!

"Your words are correct.

as for Tàipíng,

it is then lack of Píng;
if two things are harmed,

if three things are harmed,

it is then the harming of the four directions;
if five things are harmed,
it is then the harming of the five directions,

if six things are harmed,

if seven things are harmed,

if nine things are harmed,

"I wish to hear the meaning of the instructions for peace."

when the things of spring all sprout,

When interacting with such a person,
observe their words and deeds;
on a daily or monthly basis, they seem to match the human heart.
If they seem compliant and good,
but one considers and employs them over a long time,
by the month they instead make people more wicked and depraved;
if they seem good by the month,
they instead become wicked by the year;
observing the person when young,
they may seem good,
and their words seem loyal and trustworthy,
but in old age, considering and employing what they have done,
it is instead most wicked and depraved;
this is purely the conduct of a false, sycophantic, disloyal, and untrustworthy person.
When they reach old age,
exhausting their words and deeds,
they are most base.
Disaster reaches their wives and children,
and misfortune flows to their descendants."
"Wonderful, wonderful!"
Since Tàishàng and Zhōnggǔ,
people have mostly imitated words
but have not imitated actions;
thus they cause disasters, diseases, and misfortunes to accumulate,
which cannot be eliminated,
and by this they exhaust themselves.
For this reason, I respectfully received this Dào from Tiān;
I imitate what is faithful and real,
and do not imitate empty words.
For those who uphold and practice the Dào of my writings,
the people of Xiàgǔ may say daily that my Dào is bad and useless,
but conversely, after a month it proves good;
though they say for a month it is useless,
conversely, after a year it proves good;
though they say for a year it is useless,
conversely, until old age it remains constantly good,
and for a very long time it does not depart.
Later generations consider it a worldly study.
Those who do not know how to practice it diligently
only suffer in vain throughout their single lifetime.
Therefore, I instruct the Zhēnrén to always be devoted and diligent.
The Dào appears for those with virtue;
those who come first and those who come later are all the same to me, with no special favoritism or intimacy,
for I received them equally.
Therefore, those who simply obtain and vigorously practice it
are the right people;
there is no distinction between one person and another.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed:
the Tiāndào has no favorites;
it returns to the people.
The virtue of Dì is without selfishness;
it is entrusted to the diligent people.
In human relations, there is no first or last;
love is given only to those with reality and faith.
Therefore, the sovereign kings of old had palaces and dwellings to employ the virtuous,
and did not employ officials without merit.
People of virtue
are loved by Tiāndì
and can help the sovereign kings stabilize the myriad things;
people without virtue
are resented by Tiāndì
and are the thieves of Yīnyáng."
"Why is it so grave?"
"How foolish you are!
Indeed, for people without virtue,
their actions follow no principles
and thus they oppose Tiāndì;
therefore, they are at odds with Tiāndì.
They thus disrupt Yīnyáng;
therefore, they are the thieves of Yīnyáng.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
ask no more;
good and evil can be seen."
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed:
I am troubled for your sake
and will distinguish and explain the behavior of the people of Xiàgǔ for you.
Everyone says they are wise
and good at understanding affairs,
but conversely, the signs of their actions
show their virtue is bad month by month.
Month after month, each says they have good conduct
and do not fail Tiān,
but conversely, each year they encounter many disasters
and suffer misfortune, evil, and premature death.
When young, everyone says they are good and great worthies,
worthier than their fathers and mothers,
but when their conduct reaches old age,
conversely, there is not a single good or worthy person among them;
they are all unworthy people.
Poverty and lowliness are shared,
and their lifespans daily diminish;
not one knows the Zhēndào.
As for the people of Xiàgǔ,
good, evil, worthiness, and unworthiness are seen in this.
Why must they say they are worthy and understand affairs?
Simply observe the signs,
and it can be known;
it can be permanently clear,
and truth and falsehood can be put into practice.
Why must it be explained and set forth again?
Established matters are already [...].
The Zhēnrén should show them my written texts
to make them realize at once;
otherwise, they may be lost to Tiān for a long time and bear heavy resentment toward Dì.
Proceed, my words are nearly finished;
if there are later doubts,
then come and discuss them together."
"Yes, yes."
To the right is collected the "Secret of Tàipíng regarding whether Human Actions are Real or False."
The Shénrén spoke to the Zhēnrén, saying:
"At the beginning of antiquity when studying the Dào,
the spirit wandered and maintained softness to preserve itself;
accumulating virtue without ceasing, the Dào led to becoming a Xiān.
Riding clouds and driving dragons through the gates of Tiān,
moving and changing with Tiān like a cycle.
The Zhēnrén focuses on oneness and long life;
their lifespan is linked with Tiān.
The Yángdào is accumulated through focus,
brought about by daily, singular, and utmost faith.
Do not struggle for glorious names
while dwelling in high office;
serve the master with filial piety and obedience,
and the Dào will come naturally.
The spirits will then know your goodness
and will speak with you.
As for the master,
opening ignorance is the beginning of the Dào;
the ruler, the father, and the master
are the gates of life for the world.
If one can respectfully serve these three persons,
the Dào will be grandly displayed.
If one does not serve these three persons,
the room is closed without a door;
blessings and virtue all flee,
while disaster and chaos are to be pitied.
Reflect deeply upon these matters;
do not lose the words of these writings.
Parents give birth to you,
and the master teaches social relations;
when dwelling in intimacy and serving them,
can one not be cautious?
The highest scholars of the world
leave office to pursue the state of Xiān;
the state of Xiān has no end,
and their lifespan is linked with Tiān.
Local officials govern the people,
and transcendent officials are the officers of Tiān;
what business do they have with the mundane world?
Their affairs are different.
Local officials govern people, and Xiān govern the myriad spirits;
in the affairs of the world,
each has its own ruler.
Strive to think of goodness,
and the body can be made whole.
By this, one then departs
and does not fail the ancestors.
My diagrams and books are finished;
there is nothing more to set forth.
Apply yourself to study and inquire deeply into the texts."
The Shénrén was about to depart,
therefore he cautioned the Zhēnrén:
"Be careful, be careful!
Also do not transmit it recklessly;
if the right person is not found,
be careful not to bring it forth.
Hide it within the deep abyss and the dark realms.
The Dào does not drink blood;
do not speak of the essential texts.
The outer and inner are already fully known;
there is nothing more to be said."
"Before the Zhēnrén,
you shall together record my words.
Having received the texts of the Tiāndào for so long,
how could one exhaustively know the boundaries of its great divisions?
How many divisions does my Dào have,
what is considered the ultimate limit,
and what is considered the great consummation?"
"Within the texts there is the Dào,
with six limits and six consummations.
This humble student now speaks,
but does not know what are taken as the six limits and six consummations."
"Pah!
You are so foolish and unenlightened;
though your learning seems substantial,
you are not yet greatly refined,
and thus you do not know where the Dào reaches."
"Having committed a fault against the Tiānshī,
the blame certainly can never be removed;
I do not complain of it."
"The Zhēnrén blames himself
with such extreme gravity, why?"
"This humble student has heard:
If a son is unfilial,
he cannot exert his full strength to nourish his parents;
if a disciple is non-compliant,
he cannot exert his full strength to cultivate and clarify the master’s Dào;
if a minister is disloyal,
he cannot exert his full strength to respectfully serve his sovereign.
To perform these three conducts poorly
is a sin that cannot be removed.
Heaven and Earth detest it,
the Guǐshén harm it,
all people loathe it,
and even after death there is remaining blame in the underworld;
such a person is named a son of three conducts that are neither compliant nor good.
They always face judgment before Heaven at the end of the month and the dawn of the new moon,
where the correct principles of Yīnyáng are presided over.
These are the divine officials of high and low rank;
the Húnpò suffer for it
until they are extinguished.
Therefore, I know that I am not refined
and have a fault toward my master that cannot be removed."
"Excellent, excellent!
From where did you receive these words?"
"I received them from a former master.
Furthermore, this humble student has caught glimpses of the Tiānshī’s teachings,
received the Tiānshī’s methods,
and observed the Tiānxiàng.
Heaven and Earth are indeed the parents of the Sìshí and Wǔxíng.
If the Sìshí and Wǔxíng do not exert their strength to nourish what Heaven and Earth desire to bring to life,
they are unfilial children;
in such years there are few good things,
and it is a year of calamity.
Humans are also the children of Heaven and Earth;
if a child is not diligent in nourishing what Heaven and Earth have made,
they are named unfilial children.
Therefore, for those who are fond of using punishments,
their state is often in chaos, danger, and ruin.
The myriad things
decline or flourish according to the Sìshí and Wǔxíng,
growing and nourishing themselves;
they are their disciples.
If they cannot exert their strength to follow the seasonal Qì to grow, bear fruit, and age,
they ultimately become non-compliant disciples.
The things produced that year will harm people,
and they will conversely share in the guilt.
When the seasonal Qì is not in harmony,
it is because the seasonal Qì has incurred heavy faults.
The people
are the disciples of the Shèngrén and Xiánzhě.
Now, low and foolish disciples recklessly steal and forcefully explain,
conversely causing the Shèngrén and Xiánzhě to have faults;
this is named collectively causing chaos and rebelling against the Tiāndào.
The sin is extremely heavy
and cannot be pardoned or removed;
thus this humble student’s faults are not removed.
Wind and rain
are the loyal ministers of Heaven and Earth.
They receive the mandate of Heaven to move the Qì together,
but if the moisture is not balanced and even,
it causes the world to be unfair.
This is like a person receiving a mandate to be a minister to a Dìwáng:
if they turn their back on those above and face those below,
and their intentions are not balanced and even,
then the various ministers together become disloyal and untrustworthy,
collectively deceiving their superior
and causing the world to be in turmoil with many changes and contentions,
so that the governance of the state becomes dangerous and chaotic.
Comparing these three matters:
a son being unfilial,
a disciple being non-compliant,
and a minister being disloyal;
their sins are all beyond pardon.
Heaven hates them intensely,
Earth loathes them intensely,
regarding it as a great matter
and a great calamity.
The Guǐshén strongly condemn it;
therefore, it is the most evil and low behavior."
"Alas!
The Zhēnrén has long harbored wisdom yet conversely feigns foolishness,
causing me to speak recklessly
so that my words have exceeded the bounds of Heaven and Earth.
What I have said
is not as profound or far-reaching as what you have just spoken."
"This humble student’s mind has just reached this point
and now cannot say anything more."
"A great humility!
Yet it does not miss the mark either.
If one is of low rank yet not humble,
the fault is also heavy."
"Yes, yes,
I would not dare, I would not dare.
For this reason, as this humble student is a disciple
and cannot clearly comprehend the divisions and boundaries of the master's Dào,
knowing my fault is heavy,
I spoke of the Tiānxiàng to blame myself."
"Excellent!
As for your words,
I have nothing to add to them.
Now, comparing it with your explanation,
you already know it yourself.
The divisions and boundaries of the books
truly do not reach it.
However, since you indeed do not reach it,
I will distinguish and explain it for you in detail,
making each division and boundary follow in order,
so that they may never be forgotten for ten thousand generations.
Now the Zhēnrén says
that when humans’ three conducts are not compliant, cultivated, or good,
and that the Húnpò face judgment—this is extremely ingenious.
From where did you receive this □□ explanation?"
"It is as if the Tiānshī had served a former master,
and personally spoke of the admonitions for the Zhēnrén of high antiquity.
This humble student makes use of these words
and has also seen them mentioned in the texts of the Tiānshī’s books;
therefore I □□ know it deeply.
This humble student asks:
in the time of the Zhēnrén of high antiquity,
I do not know if they had doubts or complications."
"Indeed,
the words of the Zhēnrén of high antiquity are correct,
and I have nothing to add to them."
"Now I wish to ask the Tiānshī about its true meaning
and will listen with clarity."
"Indeed.
The reason for facing judgment at the end of the month and the end of the year
is not only for the Húnshén of those who were unfilial, non-compliant, disloyal, and greatly rebellious evil people when they were alive;
all the spirits of Heaven and Earth are like this.
Heaven takes fifteen days as one small boundary,
thus when the month reaches the fifteenth day, it breaks and makes a small return.
It takes one month as a middle division
and one year as a large division.
The various spirits and essences between Heaven and Earth
must together assist Heaven to together give life, nourish, and grow these twelve thousand things;
thus the various spirits and essences all obtain their salaries and sustenance.
It is like the host of ministers and Xiánzhě
who together assist a Dìwáng to nourish and grow the common people and the myriad things,
and all obtain their salaries and sustenance.
Therefore, following Heaven as the law,
they always face a small upward judgment on the fifteenth day of the month,
a middle upward judgment at one month,
and a great judgment at one year.
Thus, those with great merit are rewarded and promoted,
while those without merit are dismissed
or punished and disciplined.
Those who cause chaos in governance
are the spirits of specialized heterodoxy and evil,
and the spirits of heterodoxy and evil travel with them.
For this reason, for people who were not good when they were alive,
their Húnpò undergo judgment together,
because the Húnpò of good people are unwilling to be their servants.
Thus, people who are rebellious, unfilial, non-compliant, and disloyal are made their servants,
together throwing the Tiānyí into chaos
and defiling the Tiānzhì.
Therefore, when those evil spirits are apprehended and disciplined,
their followers are also apprehended and disciplined.
It is like when rebellious and evil ministers act without decorum,
the punishment reaches their followers;
this is what is meant."
"Excellent, excellent!
This humble student has already understood."
"Therefore, when a person is alive,
as a son, one should be filial;
as a minister, one should be loyal;
as a disciple, one should be compliant.
If filiality, loyalty, and compliance do not leave one's person,
then after death, the Húnpò and divine essence will not face judgment.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, yes.
How startling!
How startling!
Now, I only hope the Tiānshī will graciously show compassion and reveal
how many celestial laws and models there are.
I pray you do not abandon me halfway
and only show and command the reach of the written divisions and boundaries of the texts."
"Since you ask about the general number of these things,
I still ought to speak of it.
If I do not speak,
it would be named as begrudging the Dào,"
When studies are completed and stop,
one conversely attains Heavenly fitness.
"Agreed.
Six Zhēnrén, sit peacefully,
and I shall distinguish the divisions for you.
Altogether there are six categories in one great assembly.
As for those who Guard the One,
they follow according to their kind;
regarding Guarding the One in ancient and modern times,
the texts are largely the same.
When a Great Worthy sees my text,
and practices it without ceasing,
planning it to grasp its essential meaning—
such as how studying can make one a filial son,
middle-level study can make one a loyal minister—
if one studies it until old age
without stopping or slacking,
all can attain transcendence of the world.
There are still further strategies;
if one practices them without stopping,
one may even penetrate the Liù fāng bā jí.
Once all matters are completed,
what is there that one would not have?
Above, one can then assist the virtuous Dìjūn
to together stabilize Heaven and Earth.
His grace then descends,
reaching even the plants and trees.
Among all the bustling kinds of myriad things,
none are not fully ordered.
Heaven and Earth rejoice because of it;
Emperors and Kings roam long because of it,
simply sounding zithers and singing with joy,
having no more worries.
