Do you know this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"Middle Worthies guard and practice it with effort,
thinking only of its meaning morning and evening;
they can also be filial sons in youth,
and good ministers when grown,
assisting the state to achieve Tàipíng.
The whole world entirely submits,
and none fail to say, 'How excellent!'
Prudent without and faithful within,
they return to blame and correct themselves,
daring not to fail Heaven and Earth,
and daring not to deceive their superiors.
The various worthies together examine and exert themselves to practice it,
causing the ruler to govern
so that he resembles Heaven,
acting in the image of Heaven.
Benevolence and love reach down to the grass, trees, mosquitoes, and gnats,
all obtaining their proper place.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"The common people guard and read it,
together striving to practice it,
also easily and together enjoying it,
unable to restrain themselves.
It causes fathers to be kind,
mothers to be loving,
sons to be filial,
wives to be submissive,
elder brothers to be good,
and younger brothers to be respectful.
Neighbors all think of and delight in doing good,
no longer having hidden thieves or those fond of stealing and harming each other.
There are those who think fully and delight in loyalty, submission, and filiality,
wishing to reach the level of Middle and Great Worthies;
thus the people no longer know how to be wicked.
Every family and every person
disciplines and governs themselves;
thus it can be governed without punishments.
Superior, middle, and inferior people together practice it,
and the world is immediately peaceful within no time.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"Therefore, in the Way of Guarding the One,
those who have obtained Guarding the One in ancient and modern times
are again gathered by category.
If Superior Worthies clearly and diligently do it,
they can attain transcendence of the world;
if Middle Worthies diligently do it,
they can become good assistants and excellent officials for Emperors and Kings;
if small people diligently do it,
they will not know joy or anger,
and the world will have no resentment or blame.
This
is the first part and the great division of my book.
Fearing that worldly people accumulate stupidity
and have been confused for a long time,
not believing my text,
I therefore teach and show them,
making it match with ancient and modern texts on Guarding the One
and following according to category,
so as to provide proof."
"Wonderful, wonderful!
I, your foolish pupil, have respectfully awakened."
"Regarding Guarding the One,
great people guarding it also have abundance,
middle people guarding it also have abundance,
and small people guarding it also have abundance.
When all three types of people guard and practice it together,
their goodness then penetrates and saturates the Six Directions and Eight Distances,
and their benevolence and love are calculated equally with Heaven and Earth.
If among the most inferior and foolish
there are those who do not delight in guarding and practicing it,
they are named the most wicked and evil people in the world;
Heaven and Earth detest them,
and ghosts and spirits no longer protect them.
When common people together for a long time do not find it beneficial,
this is the method by which the Heavenly Script distinguishes people's good and evil.
Those who like and wish to read and look at it,
Heaven knows to be good people;
those who are shown it but do not wish to look at it,
Heaven knows to be wicked and evil people.
Judging people by this,
not one in ten thousand is missed.
I write this text for the Lord of Superior Virtue,
above not failing Heaven,
below not failing Earth,
in the middle not failing the Lord of Virtue,
and not deceiving the Zhēnrén.
For those who guard this and grasp its meaning,
the Way is already complete and finished.
Six Zhēnrén, deeply contemplate its meaning for yourselves;
I cannot fully record all the goodness of this.
The One
is the essential key of the Great Way.
It is what the superior man delights in as virtue,
what the middle man echoes and knows,
and what the inferior man detests and hates.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"Therefore, when the superior man obtains it, he is greatly joyful
and cannot restrain himself from acting on it;
when the middle man obtains it,
he does not stop himself,
always happy and wishing to speak of it;
when the inferior man sees it,
it is his great taboo.
Observing these three types of people through my text,
the good and evil of the world are then clearly distinguished.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"This text is that by which Heaven authenticates and corrects the hearts of common people,
to remove the remaining disasters of Chéngfù transmitted from ancestors in later antiquity,
to cure the sickness of Heaven,
and to remove the blame of Chéngfù from the Lord of Superior Virtue.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"Wonderful, wonderful!
Proceed,
you have already awakened."
Regarding the second division:
those who read the Daoist texts of my book,
matching ancient and modern times
and following according to category,
all grasp its essential meaning.
Superior Worthies clearly and collectively rejoice in it,
unable to restrain themselves from doing good.
They go so far as to dare enter a thatched hut,
firmly guarding it without loss,
and they will surely attain transcendence of the world and depart.
Their will merges greatly and penetrates with the spirits,
and they no longer seek praise in worldly matters.
Their goodness then penetrates, investigates, and saturates Heaven and Earth;
their spirit then assists Heaven and Earth,
returning again to assist Emperors and Kings in transforming evil.
Grace descends to plants, trees, and the small and minute,
and none are not covered by their virtuous transformation.
Therefore, the worthy and virtuous teachers of old,
those who could assist Emperors and Kings in achieving Tàipíng,
were all this kind of person.
Thus their words and deeds are all compliant, good, loyal, and faithful;
this is because the Daoist master from whom they received the teachings was good.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, indeed."
"Among them, Middle Worthies together strive to read my book and texts,
matching ancient and modern Daoist books and texts,
following according to category,
and striving to read together without stopping.
Those with worthy talent
can above become good assistants and excellent officials for Emperors and Kings,
assisting the Lord of Virtue to transform evil,
with grace descending to the small, minute, plants, and trees.
Yīn yáng harmonize,
and no longer are there those who fight and battle.
Emperors and Kings roam long without worrisome matters,
and ministers and subjects below together show and teach, striving to do it.
None are not compliant, good, loyal, and faithful;
they govern without punishments,
and their goodness cannot be fully written.
"Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"If the common people all read the texts of my Dào together,
communicating from above to below throughout the capital,
combining their efforts and sharing the same plan as one,
there would no longer be any knowledge of what is ominous or evil.
Collate and examine the Dào texts of ancient and modern times,
categorizing them by type to clarify one another,
and thus establish them as a universal learning,
transmitted from father to son without end.
If the Great Worthy, the Middle Worthy, the Lesser Worthy, and the common people all perform divinations for this,
the evil qi of Heaven and Earth will be completely removed,
and there will no longer be the disasters of Chéngfù.
Goodness will then harmonize Yīn and Yáng;
the harmonious qi and auspicious omens of Heaven and Earth will all emerge,
wandering through the capitals of emperors and kings;
this is the proof that Huángtiān and Hòutǔ are pleased and joyful.
Therefore, those who read my writings
should be meticulous and detailed with them.
From top to bottom,
contemplate their essential meaning;
once the secret formula is obtained,
one will be no different from the divine spirits.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Regarding the three realms:
a person who attains the Dào must see many spirits and be able to command them.
The superior and wise among them
succeed in ten out of ten cases;
they can serve as emperors and kings,
or as ministers who repel the heterodox and remove the evil;
or after a long time, they may be able to enter a máo shì and transcend,
no longer seeking reputation in mundane affairs.
Therefore, one must Shǒu Yī and then fully know the places of good, evil, and error;
only then can one maintain the Dào,
entering a máo shì for refined cultivation;
and only then can one Shǒu Shén;
thus this is the third stage.
The Worthy are able to collate ancient and modern divine books to prove them against each other.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"The Middle Worthy who Shǒu Yī and enter the Dào
will also see spirits for themselves
and succeed in nine out of ten cases;
they can serve as kings, marquises, and great ministers,
together repelling and eliminating the heterodox and evil;
or after a long time, they may also hope to enter a máo shì.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"The Lesser Worthy who Shǒu Yī,
enter the Dào, and read the books
may also see spirits
and succeed in eight out of ten cases;
they can serve the common people to repel the heterodox and eliminate the evil.
They should all also collate ancient and modern Dào texts
to prove them to one another,
so that even the foolish may become enlightened
and fully understand and believe in the Dào.
If one is made to read only a single volume of books,
one will certainly not believe in it.
On the contrary, one will speak of its faults to justify oneself,
then heterodoxy and evil will rise daily
and be able to harm people.
If the Great Worthy, the Middle Worthy, and those down to the common people
all maintain the Divine Dào and act according to it,
then the spirits of Heaven, Earth, and the Four Seasons will all rise,
and the heterodox will naturally perish.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"In this way,
the spirits above the heavens and upon the earth, of the four directions, the six categories, and the six relations,
will all be joyful and rise greatly
to assist people in being auspicious
and to resolve heterodox harm.
Above, they remove disasters and illnesses for emperors and kings;
in the middle, they remove ailments for the Worthy;
and below, they remove evil qi for the common people,
preventing wicked ghosts and entities from acting."
"Excellent, excellent!
There must be a great secret instruction and precept
for seeing spirits to divine matters."
"To say ten out of ten are accurate
means the law corresponds with the celestial spirits;
to say nine out of ten are accurate
means it corresponds with the terrestrial spirits;
to say eight out of ten are accurate
means it corresponds with the human spirits.
For anything lower than this,
the words cannot be used.
There may be those who first see spirits
and conversely have ten out of ten correspondences,
but after a long time, conversely fail day by day;
they are being tested by the Divine Dào,
which causes them to fail.
Seeing this, if they can renew themselves,
exerting themselves to correct their thoughts and errors,
becoming more refined and good
without any evil intent,
they will again advance day by day;
perhaps matching the intent of the spirits,
they will then hit ten out of ten,
or even go beyond ten,
or hit ten,
and thus hit the full ten.
Those who day by day achieve great accuracy and advance upward
are those who daily think of doing good
and have obtained the intent of the Dào.
Therefore it is called progress.
Using this to divine for oneself,
in ten thousand cases, not one will fail.
There may be those who first see spirits
and their divination of matters is not accurate,
yet they have already turned to daily advance upward with great accuracy;
these are people whose essence has obtained the divine intent of the Dào and advances daily.
There may be those who remain mediocre as before,
neither advancing nor retreating;
these are people whose application of essence does not exceed their past.
Those who decline daily
are called negligent people;
divining by this,
they have not obtained the intent of the Dào.
Being tested and yet not realizing it,
stubbornly remaining as they were and doing evil,
the various spirits will together deceive them.
Leading them into heterodoxy,
it results in luck and misfortune being inconstant;
or they enter into demonic speech,
or they are beset by illness and stop.
Therefore, whether Great Worthy, Middle Worthy, Lesser Worthy, or common men and women practicing the Dào,
they should all use this to divine for themselves
and they will not fail;
is it not that the Divine Dào tests people?
Generally, all affairs under heaven
are ruined by testing.
Heaven and Earth have tests for people,
therefore people also imitate Heaven and Earth
in testing one another.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"You wish further to know its great and reliable efficacy:
the divine spirits of the Heavenly Dào and the people satisfy each other's intent,
aligning with the heart
and reaching sincere trust.
If they do not satisfy each other's intent,
then they deceive each other.
For this reason, the people of high antiquity were sincere and satisfied each other's intent,
so those above and below did not deceive one another;
the people of middle antiquity were half-satisfied in intent,
so they half-deceived one another;
the people of low antiquity were completely untrusting,
so those above and below made a business of completely deceiving one another.
Thus in high antiquity, in undertaking affairs, all were accurate;
in middle antiquity, half were accurate;
in low antiquity, none were accurate,
resulting in peril and ruin.
Therefore, the worthies and sages of old
always used this to divine for themselves whether they could obtain success or not,
then they would have no failure.
Using this to admonish the Zhēnrén,
I see you often suffer from toil,
therefore I deeply admonish you,
so that you may serve as a long-term emissary for Heaven and Earth.
Resolving the flowing disasters of Heaven and Earth
and removing harm for the rulers,
the merit is extremely great and has few peers.
Fearing you might become negligent in the Dào,
I therefore use these divine matters to admonish you.
You serve as the emissary of Heaven and Earth,
and when the days are auspicious,
it is because you have obtained the heart and intent of Heaven and Earth;
when the days are ominous, declining, and evil,
it is because you have lost the heart and intent of Heaven and Earth.
In communion with the spirits of the Dào,
when days are auspicious and good,
it is because you have obtained the heart and intent of the Dào;
when days are ominous and declining,
it is because you have lost the heart and intent of the Dào.
In communion with people,
when daily growing more generous and good,
it is because you have satisfied each other's heart and intent;
if conversely, relations daily become ominous, evil, and thin,
it is because you have lost each other's heart and intent.
It is like tilling a field:
if the grain alone becomes full and good,
it is because one’s application of the mind was meticulous
and the effort expended was great;
if in tilling, the grain obtained is little and not good or full,
it is because one's application of the mind was slightly negligent
and the effort expended was small."
These are merely plants and trees,
yet they still follow the intentions of the human heart, their goodness or badness depending on the amount of effort and hardship expended.
How much more so then for the divine spirits of Heaven and Earth and for mankind?
Can one not be cautious?
The Zhēnrén also takes this as a warning.
Though it may seem slight and not worth mentioning,
if one ponders it deeply,
it will on the contrary become of great importance.
This is precisely what is called the gateway to safety and peril, to good fortune and ill luck.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
This humble student has already awakened to it.
I receive your command, I receive your command."
"Now, a Shàngdé Jūn of high virtue and enlightenment examines documents from high, middle, and low antiquity,
categorizes them by type,
cross-references them for proof,
and the Dào is suddenly corrected,
becoming as clear as the sun and moon.
He also gathers the worthies of high, middle, and low ranks, as well as the oral traditions and resolutions of common men and women,
categorizes them by type,
and cross-references them.
When the written texts are largely unified,
it is like matching a compass and a square;
there is no discrepancy.
The plans of Heaven, Earth, and Man are all unified
as if they were one.
In this way, the true essence of Heaven, Earth, and Man is fully present,
and the twelve thousand things are the same.
Therefore, a Shàngdé Jūn should strive to apply this.
Then disasters will vanish in a day,
the world will govern itself,
there will be no remaining heterodox texts or words,
and everything will be transparently white and correct,
leaving no residual heterodox Qì.
Heterodox texts and words
are the roots that bind disasters.
If you wish to know more of its clarity and reliability,
consider when people use heterodox texts to report to the ruler,
or use heterodox words to slander others.
Resentment and blame will rise daily,
many people will mutually resent and slander each other,
and the ruler listens to them.
Consequently, he loses his correctness and his intelligence is blocked.
He is criticized by Heaven and Earth,
and his dangerous words are inauspicious.
Furthermore, those below use heterodox texts and words to deceive and delude those above.
When the ruler eventually realizes this,
there is mutual blame between ruler and minister.
Thus, these heterodox texts and words arriving daily
are the gateway to misfortune and evil.
Therefore, one must strive to examine and remove them.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Therefore, if a Shàngdé Jūn uses only correct words,
then since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
the calamities of Chéngfù will all be removed,
and disasters will no longer occur.
The Zhēnrén wishes to know more of its great reliability.
Correct texts and correct words
are the true roots and foundations of Heaven, Earth, Man, and the myriad things.
Thus, when the great Sages and Worthies of high antiquity followed correct texts and words,
Heaven became correct for them,
the Sānguāng became correct for them,
the Four Seasons and Five Elements became correct for them,
and the people and all things became correct for them.
Thus, correct texts and correct words
are the great proof and correct root for Heaven, Earth, the people, and the myriad things.
If you wish to clearly know its reliability,
consider when people use correct texts and words to praise others before the ruler.
The ruler gains great intelligence and understanding,
everything he undertakes is successful,
and none lose their correctness.
Then those above and below obtain the heart and mind of Heaven and Earth.
The Sānguāng do not lose their courses,
the Four Seasons and Five Elements are not in error,
the people are all joyful,
saying 'how good!',
and the myriad things each find their place.
Benevolence reaches the spirits and deities,
fame spreads to distant lands,
and the various spirits, auspicious omens, and rare objects appear in joy.
The world's worthies and scholars all happily go to assist the ruler,
for nothing is hidden.
Immortals and divine spirits bring the formulas of longevity to him.
Ill omens are extinguished,
and the people govern themselves according to the administration.
When there are correct texts and words, there are no longer those who hate each other,
and resentment and blame are cut off.
All good in the world emerges,
and all evil is hidden.
The Shàngdé Jūn need only let his robes hang and govern effortlessly.
What worry of danger or ruin could there be?
This is the clear proof and effect of my correct texts and words being the root of goodness.
How can one not strive to correct them?
Does the Zhēnrén understand?"
"Yes, yes.
How startling!
Having seen the words of the Tiānshī,
I have already been greatly awakened.
This humble student knows that the world is already at Tàipíng.
If the Shàngdé Jūn listens and employs this,
he will have already extended his life."
"Excellent!
You can be called a student who understands matters,
and you have already thoroughly known it.
What joy, what joy!
Heaven's worry is resolved;
Earth's illness is removed.
How does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Indeed,
all these evils should be seen as removed,
and the great illness of Heaven, Earth, people, and the myriad things is already gone.
Now that the correct texts and words have been examined and corrected,
therefore I know the great illness of Heaven and Earth is already removed."
"Excellent, excellent!
You have already [missing text] known it.
If kings and emperors strive to practice my texts,
they will be as profound as Heaven and Earth
and will no longer face periods of calamity.
Excellent, excellent!
I shall tell the Zhēnrén a great essential saying.
When a Shàngdé Jūn obtains my texts,
he should model himself after Heaven's laws to appoint officials,
from the Shénrén above
down to the lowly and humble,
in total nine types of people.
Shén, Zhēn,
Xiān, Dào,
Shèng, Xián,
Fánmín,
Nú, and Bì.
If these nine types of people have true faith and loyalty,
and possess goodness, the true Dào, and joy,
coming to assist the Shàngdé Jūn,
he should ask of their abilities and appoint them.
Be careful not to assign them to positions that do not fit them,
nor should you reject or drive them away.
This is called opposing the diligent and devoted hearts of people.
Heaven is not a person,
but relies on and employs them,
asking each for their strengths;
then there is nothing that is not governed.
The Shàngdé Jūn should test them;
those who show good results daily should be promoted,
being careful not to lose them.
Those without results should be quickly dismissed.
This is called polluting and disordering the offices of Heaven,
preventing the correct Qì from coming;
the blame lies with these heterodox people.
Correct and good people
always desire to secretly assist and worry for all matters;
thus it is called 'bringing in correct and good people.'
Heterodox people have heterodox hearts
and do not wish to secretly assist or benefit all matters;
thus they bring about heterodoxy.
This is the natural law and standard of Huángtiān.
Therefore, they should be dismissed immediately;
if not dismissed, they will anger Heaven,
causing the killing Qì of Earth to emerge.
Thus they must be quickly removed;
this is a great matter.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes.
This humble student fears it greatly."
"If you know to fear it,
you can be called a student who understands matters,
and Heaven will protect you."
"I dare not, I dare not."
"There is no need for such modesty.
It is not I who cause you to be protected by Heaven;
rather, by doing good,
you naturally attain it through your own conduct.
Thus, when the Sages of old acted,
they did not dare to deviate from the marking line.
They observed the warnings of Heaven,
clearly knowing good and evil,
and acted for their own sakes.
Thus, they always sought to govern with the worthies,
fearing they might anger Heaven.
If one offends Heaven,
there is nowhere to pray.
Therefore, the emperors and kings of old
had minds that were clear and perceptive;
they did not dare to recklessly work with the foolish.
Thus, they alone obtained long-lasting auspiciousness.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Since middle antiquity,
half the people have been foolish.
They treated selection and recommendation as a minor matter
and did not examine it carefully.
Half the time they got the wrong people,
which half-disordered the offices of Heaven,
and governance was half-inauspicious.
In low antiquity, the Chéngfù of middle antiquity's negligence was again followed.
Furthermore, they made it easy for themselves
and did not examine things carefully.
Most of the time, the selections did not yield the right people;
they polluted and disordered the offices of Heaven,
causing the Sānguāng to lose their correctness.
This proof is seen above in Heaven,
and Heaven is not pleased.
Thus, many bad years continue without end;
even when they end, they rise again.
They do not know that Heaven deeply resents and loathes this.
People do not deeply blame themselves,
but instead say it is the cycle of heavenly timing.
There have been such people since olden times.
The Way of Heaven is not like man,
but they turn back and attribute their own excesses to Heaven above.
The foolish below do not reflect on their own faults,
but instead turn back and together blame the emperors and kings.
Heaven names these the people of great rebellion."
Errors are transmitted from below to deceive those above;
they take evil for good
and good for evil.
Together they bring about these disasters,
yet they turn around and attribute them to Heaven above.
Having attributed them to Heaven,
they then further reproach their sovereign;
they are the most thoroughly wicked and unruly subjects under Heaven.
Now the divine spirits of Heaven and Earth collectively loathe them;
therefore Heaven has personally visited,
sending me down for the sake of the virtuous sovereign
to reform and establish the laws.
In the selection and appointment of people to official posts,
one must be cautious and thorough.
If the Zhēnrén wishes to know the scrutiny of these wicked subjects,
consider it like the parents of a family
who together bear several children.
If the children collectively deceive their parents
and act wickedly,
while the parents sit quietly in a room at home,
peacefully unaware,
and the children have already committed heinous crimes and robberies,
people instead return to blame the parents.
They say the parents are evil,
"and therefore they gave birth to us who are evil."
When the county officials catch them,
they do not simply execute the wicked children,
but instead turn back to blame the parents.
Now, when parents give birth to children,
they all delight in them being worthy and good;
when would they ever delight in your wicked behavior?
To turn back and blame the parents
makes one a most rebellious and unfilial child.
Now, regarding what a sovereign says of his subjects,
he always delights in them doing good;
when would he ever teach them to do evil?
Yet when the people and subjects themselves act wickedly from below
and receive disasters from Heaven and Earth,
they instead turn back to blame and reproach their sovereign,
and the common people suffer in distress.
Thereupon, the cunning officials also join in reproaching Heaven above;
this is called the collective rebellion of people and subjects,
a sin that cannot be absolved.
Having reproached their sovereign to the extreme,
the response has already become most severe.
Yet they further go on to reproach Heaven above
and reproach Earth below;
the rebellion of man is such as this—
how could one not shorten their lives and swiftly execute them?
Therefore, in late antiquity, all correspond to the mandates of hegemony;
life and death have no fixed time.
It is like a common family wishing to slaughter livestock;
if they suddenly wish to kill it,
they simply kill it.
A good animal is still pitied in its death,
but for a bad animal, one delights in its death by disease.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes.
This humble student greatly fears the majesty of Heaven."
"Very well,
you have understood.
Bring forth this text
and have the virtuous sovereign show it to the worthy scholars;
be careful not to hide it,
for Heaven delights in its swift distribution."
"Yes, yes."
"I shall tell the Zhēnrén a great essential:
when a highly virtuous sovereign has appointed officials and each is the right person,
matching the heart of Heaven,
then he shall know the methods of governing the people and eliminating harm.
Now, those who hide in the four distant regions
are very difficult to know.
Those lowly and foolish people
each seek their own profit
and turn around to collectively deceive their superiors.
A virtuous sovereign should rectify this together with the worthy and wise;
to rectify everything is the intent of Heaven and Earth,
and it will bring great joy,
making the Emperor's reign long and auspicious.
Heaven clearly knows that people of late antiquity are foolish and hard to govern;
for this reason, it has specifically issued this contract-text called the Tiānshū.
The use of writing as a law
is to make things manifest
and clear.
All under Heaven use it together to record events;
it should be followed by all,
and can record the writings of all people under Heaven.
Therefore, written documents
are what all people under Heaven should read together;
they are not produced for a single individual alone.
Thus, the world collectively uses them to record all matters;
sages collectively use them to record the patterns of Heaven and Earth;
and worthies use them to record the words of sages.
All people should learn and read them together;
only then can they grasp the meaning.
As for the nature of writing,
it should be collectively investigated, planned, recorded, and recited;
only then can there be no villainy.
Therefore, from ancient times to the present,
regarding the writings of sages and worthies:
how much has been collated,
how much has been transmitted,
how much has been verified,
and how much has been collectively agreed upon?
There still persist superfluous heterodox texts and erroneous phrases,
so they cannot be followed purely.
Therefore, great worthies and various Dàoshì
travel throughout the world,
examining phrases and practicing speeches,
observing similarities and differences
to return and instruct the ignorant;
yet they still persist in misleading innocent people.
To allow them to speak recklessly of their learning is unacceptable;
those who take office through reckless means are not fit to be the Emperor's subjects.
Thus, from a single original text,
there are numerous chapters and sentences, and thus divergent interpretations.
This causes the Way of Heaven and Earth
to fall into great disorder and lack of principle;
thus, the disasters of Chéngfù arise.
Does the Zhēnrén know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Very well,
you have understood.
Listen more clearly,
and I shall tell you a great warning.
The reason people of late antiquity have long lost the heart of Heaven
and caused Heaven and Earth to be constantly distressed
is that the sovereign uses solitary words and isolated disorder,
and the verification of matters is not truthful;
it is clear that the intent is greatly lost.
If the Zhēnrén simply presents this to the sovereign,
but allows the many worthies of the world to collectively examine the phrases and texts without understanding,
then all will become erroneous learning;
thus, disasters and anomalies will arise without end.
Heaven greatly loathes this,
for disorder causes illness there,
and Yīnyáng battle without ceasing.
Therefore, Heaven instructed me to descend
to capture, collate, and rectify it.
Now, since the ages of Great Middle Antiquity,
people have believed in isolated phrases and solitary words;
they regard every document submitted from below with disrespect,
and collectively use these to prosecute crimes against each other,
consequently using isolated phrases and solitary words.
In response, they submit documents to handle affairs,
thus creating resentment and disorder against Heaven.
Heavenly official documents were originally intended to make people collectively debate their right and wrong;
instead, they allow one person to secretly compose the phrases.
Even a sage does not solitary and completely know the Way of Heaven and Earth;
therefore, what sages and worthies of different times have produced varies,
as Heaven says each excels in one part.
Since one cannot entirely eliminate disasters alone,
I was taught to collect and collate them all together.
Now, if one instead believes the words of one person,
can that possibly be used?
Therefore, teach them the 'Triple Path of Circulating Documents,'
where the great and small, the worthy and the unworthy, men and women, all participate in cross-referencing,
collectively debating right and wrong,
making all obtain their truthful verification,
only then can it be submitted to the sovereign.
If one person among them wishes to deceive,
record it immediately.
In this way, the illness of Heaven and Earth will be cured,
and the Emperor will no longer have the burden of Chéngfù.
Heaven and Earth will be without illness and will rejoice;
the Emperor will find peace and will rejoice;
the worthy will be able to express themselves and will rejoice;
the common people will be able to explain themselves and not suffer injustice,
families will be wealthy and people satisfied, and they will rejoice;
slaves and servants will find their masters,
and not do wrong, and they will rejoice;
the Four Seasons and Five Elements will proceed in order,
the people will be cautious and not violate them, and they will rejoice;
the myriad creatures will each find their proper place,
without being harmed, and they will rejoice;
the ghosts and spirits, seeing that a virtuous sovereign can accumulate goodness,
will also be pleased and rejoice;
evil Qi will no longer rise to obscure the Sun, Moon, and the Sānguāng, and they too will rejoice;
the Tàishàng píngqì will come to govern,
and the King who applies it will also rejoice;
evil Qi will be concealed and hidden,
and not being seen or subject to execution, it too will rejoice;
the Yídí will find peace in their lands,
no longer frequently coming to battle for Heaven, and they will rejoice;
commanders will let weapons rest unused,
and the soldiers, not dying in battle, will also rejoice.
In general, between Heaven and Earth,
such joys are numerous,
too many to record.
For the Zhēnrén, I have raised the main points;
having seen the beginning,
you should contemplate its meaning yourself.
In all things, infer by category,
and everything will be grasped.
If the virtuous sovereign carries this out,
all under Heaven will submit.
Therefore, Heaven is particularly urgent about this 'Triple Path of Circulating Documents';
be careful never to neglect it again,
otherwise, disasters will not depart.
If one wishes to determine the writings of Heaven...
Repeatedly practicing the governance of the deaf and blind.
Now, the governance of the deaf and blind
is the root of disorder and danger
and the disaster that destroys the self.
Can one not be cautious?
Now, the writings
are what the people of the world should jointly examine and practice;
one cannot trust the words of a single person.
Therefore, since the opening of heaven and earth,
written documents and human speeches
have been passed down to investigate and clarify each other;
without investigating and clarifying them, one cannot act alone.
If one trusts only one person's words and acts upon them,
then there is danger and ruin.
This is a great loss and injury to the world.
Thus, my book does not dare to contain solitary words or isolated phrases;
therefore, I teach the Zhēnrén to collect and compare the writings of high antiquity, middle antiquity, and low antiquity to clarify each other,
and to collect and compare the speeches of all ordinary people in the world to provide verification,
so that thereafter the space between heaven and earth can be corrected
and there will be no illness between Yīn and Yáng.
Using my book to go and investigate the astronomical, terrestrial spirit writings, and human speeches of past and present,
they will surely respond like an echo
and be no different from the spirits;
then my Dào can be trusted.
Therefore, as I practice the Dào,
I do not merely test words,
but seek to test whether it works in practice;
how else would I know that my Dào corresponds with Heaven and is trustworthy?
If it is practiced today,
it is like speaking with Heaven;
in tens and fives,
none are missing.
How divine is the practice of the Dào like this!
Truly, it can be called great joy.
Does the Zhēnrén understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go then;
the understanding of affairs is born.
I tell the Zhēnrén a great secret formula:
this root is to Shǒuyī and focus on goodness.
If you grasp its meaning,
then you can enter the Dào;
therefore, it is followed by the Writings of the Dào.
Practicing the Dào reaches the point of Entering the Chamber;
one enters the True Dào.
And to enter the chamber, one must know the spirits;
therefore, it is followed by the Spirit Precepts.
Gaining Shǒuyī, the Dào, and the spirits,
one will surely be able to serve as a virtuous ruler (Dékūn) or a fine official for emperors and kings.
As for officials,
they must assist emperors, kings, and the Dékūn
to jointly pacify the six directions and eight caves of heaven and earth;
if they grasp this meaning,
then the state can have long-lasting peace.
If one wishes to pacify it,
one must rectify writings, rectify phrases, and rectify speech.
Therefore, by collecting and comparing writings and phrases,
great rectification is achieved.
Surely, groups of worthies and superior scholars will emerge
to jointly assist emperors and kings,
acting as their eyes, ears, and limbs;
therefore, it is followed by the Nine Classes of Officials.
When the nine classes each find their proper place,
they shall jointly pacify heaven and earth,
and the world will combine its strength and hearts as one.
They must always interact and communicate with each other,
reporting good and evil to each other;
therefore, it is followed by the Three Ways of Circulating Documents.
When people all know how to Shǒuyī,
have entered the Dào,
have entered the spirits,
and have entered the rectified writings,
then through the hierarchy of officials,
each finds their place.
When the documents have been circulated
and efforts are combined in the six matters,
having reached the ultimate,
the whole world shares one heart,
and none dare to hate each other again.
All will love and benefit each other,
as if born from the same parents;
therefore, the Dékūn deeply gains the heart of Heaven,
rejoicing in non-action.
Fearing that there might be omissions in the Dào
and that the writings of heaven and earth would not be complete,
therefore, it is followed by the Difficulties of the Great Collection
to resolve those doubts.
The profound matters are placed below;
when all the books are produced,
deliver the books to the Dékūn,
and once the world changes its plans,
it will spontaneously respond with goodness and govern itself.
Its ease is like fire following what is high and dry
or water flowing downward;
without being taught what to do,
it goes there naturally
and cannot be stopped.
Therefore, for the transformation through the Dào of the Tàihuáng Tiān,
it can be achieved instantly.
If the Dékūn practices it,
he is named the Divine Son of Heaven,
titled the Shànghuáng,
being similar to the Yuánqì of heaven and earth.
Therefore, the spirits of the world
can all be commanded.
Since the opening of heaven and earth,
there have never been heavenly books or divine writings
that have allowed the Zhēnrén to transmit them as the Record of the True Dào.
Go and deliver them to the Dékūn;
it is named the Mother of the Dào.
The Qi of Tàiyáng
exists in the movement of Fire;
if one obtains and practices it,
one obtains its proof;
if one does not know how to practice it,
then it is not true.
Does the Zhēnrén understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
I truly rely on being a cautious person;
I will go and deliver it to the Dékūn,
not daring to keep it for long."
"Go,
you have already understood it.
Heavenly books cannot be kept for long.
The heavenly spirits investigate people
and bring misfortune upon them.
Be cautious with it;
go now."
"Yes, yes."
The six investigations permeate the Dòngjí and the seven completions are reached,
arranging the books and writings by category so they complement each other;
disasters will all perish,
bringing about the auspicious writings of the Dòngjí.
"Zhēnrén, come forward."
"Yes, yes."
"Now I shall give the Zhēnrén a great warning.
My Dào is for ordering heaven and earth,
pacifying emperors and kings,
and giving life to what heaven and earth love;
thus one must love the True Dào and True Virtue.
Therefore, Heaven
is the truth of the Dào,
the guiding principle of the Dào,
the trust of the Dào,
and that upon which the Dào depends to act.
Earth
is the growth of Virtue,
the record of Virtue,
and that upon which Virtue depends to rest.
Therefore, it can forever be the mother of all things,
always enduring humiliation and dwelling below,
and never speaking of its own toil and suffering.
My teaching for the Dékūn to transform the ignorant below
takes exactly these two matters of Heaven and Earth as the ancestor.
Therefore, always examine the laws and measures of heaven and earth,
and do not lose their gateway.
My book is the speech of Heaven and the talk of Earth,
deeply and uniquely corresponding with the spirits of heaven and earth like the outside and inside of a garment.
Every step follows like a compass and square.
Therefore, those who follow and practice it gain the intent of heaven and earth;
those who lose it will face misfortune and decline.
Now I use this to warn the Zhēnrén;
you should contemplate my words and always be cautious."
"Yes, yes."
"Go.
I see that you love the True Dào and Virtue,
and your love for doing good has few equals,
so I shall show you one more word.
Now, superior scholars mostly rejoice in the True Dào and good virtue,
middle scholars half-like them,
and lower scholars are degenerate;
purely without Dào and without Virtue,
they all correspond to people of great rebellion and lawlessness.
People of great misfortune and no virtue
are uniquely incomparable with anything within heaven and earth;
they do not know each other,
and they are not what Heaven constantly pardons,
even though I love you.
Therefore, those without Dào or Virtue
do not have their fate within heaven and earth;
they share the same rewards and fate as birds and beasts."
"I do not understand yet;
I wish to hear the essential meaning."
"So,
let the six Zhēnrén listen clearly."
"Yes, yes."
"So,
Heaven is purely Dào,
Earth is purely Virtue;
these people without Dào or Virtue
are severed from heaven and earth
and belong to nothing that can be imaged.
When imaging the movement of Heaven,
one should have the True Dào and love life;
when imaging Earth,
one should have good virtue and love nourishing and growing.
People today lack Dào and lack Dé,
therefore Heaven and Earth do not forgive you.
If you wish to know the clear and trustworthy proof of this,
it is like a person of Dào knowing a person of Dào,
and a person of Dé knowing a person of Dé,
each recognizing and accepting one another;
thus their destinies are mutually present in each other.
Therefore, those of Dào enjoy promoting those of Dào,
and those of Dé enjoy promoting those of Dé.
A person with Dào and Dé and a person without Dào and Dé do not match,
so they are unwilling to recognize and accept each other,
and their destiny is not bound to Heaven."
"Excellent, excellent!
I wish to hear the meaning of sharing the same destiny as birds and beasts."
"Excellent is your inquiry;
it deeply grasps the principle.
Indeed,
the destiny of birds and beasts is tied to the four directions;
their nature is to enjoy clashing with one another,
lacking Dào and Dé,
where the victor is held superior.
Ignorant people of the lower sort who lack Dào and Dé
also enjoy clashing and offending others,
and the victor is held superior.
Their Qì is the same as that of birds and beasts,
therefore they share the same destiny.
The Tiāndào serves as the law
by which the excellence or inferiority of humans is distinguished;
thus it is known.
Regarding all names and destinies under Heaven,
they all follow their own kind;
thus one knows where their destiny belongs.
Therefore, those who contain much of the Five Natures resemble Yáng and are benevolent;
those who contain much of the Six Passions resemble Yīn and are greedy;
those who receive much of the bestowal of Yáng become male;
those who receive much of the bestowal of Yīn become female;
those who receive much of the 'Prosperous' and 'Assisting' Qì are noble and thus long-lived;
those who receive much of the 'Retired,' 'Abandoned,' or 'Imprisoned' Qì are frequently ill and die young,
and are also extremely poor.
Therefore, for all human life,
it depends on which of the Five Elements' Qì they resemble,
and their destiny is tied to which calendar of the Liùjiǎ;
by divining according to their kind,
ten thousand cases will not miss even one.
Thus the Sages of antiquity deeply investigated all matters,
and it was through this that they knew human circumstances.
Does the Zhēnrén understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
Excellent, excellent!"
"Now, the people of the latter ages
bear the burden of the failed plans of their ancestors,
gradually and collectively severing themselves from Dào and Dé.
Day by day this has accumulated over a long time,
cutting them off from Heaven and Earth;
their refined Qì does not circulate,
they do not know their own destinies,
but instead share the same destiny as the four-legged beasts.
Therefore, Heaven and Earth loathe them,
and the refined Qì of ghosts and spirits consequently does not protect them.
Their illnesses are countless,
and their killings are without end;
the great calamity lies in this.
Now, a ruler of superior Dé,
whose destiny is tied to Heaven and Earth,
should further model himself after Heaven and Earth and govern with Dào and Dé.
Therefore, I have further organized and brought forth the Tiāndào to entrust to him.
Heaven delights in his doing good
and does not wish to let him have excesses again,
for that is the behavior of 'four-legged' people.
Thus my book repeatedly gives careful warnings,
wishing to bring about a great awakening.
Therefore, I have narrated the 'Six Extremes and One Great Collection' to entrust to him.
Does the Zhēnrén understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
How startling!
How joyful, how joyful!"
"How does the Zhēnrén know it is startling yet joyful?"
"Indeed,
I, your humble student, see the Tiānshī's words
that when true Dào and Dé emerge,
the people will transform in a single morning;
all will maintain Dào and Dé,
modeling themselves after Heaven and Earth,
and no longer behaving like 'four-legged' people.
Every person will have Dào,
every person will have Dé;
thus I know the profound meaning of this great joy."
"Excellent,
the words of the Zhēnrén
cannot be surpassed."
"Now I wish to take this opportunity to ask the Tiānshī one more thing."
"Speak."
"When people today seek Dào and Dé and commoners conduct themselves,
what should be the most urgent priority?
By what means can they know this?
By what means can they resonate and respond to Heaven and Earth?"
"Excellent
is your question.
One must act with utmost sincerity and the true feelings of the five internal organs;
only then can it be achieved.
If one does not act with the true feelings of the five internal organs,
this is what Dào and Dé resent;
goodness cannot be attained,
and the divine spirits will not respond."
"I now wish to hear how utmost sincerity moves Heaven, Earth, and the divine spirits."
"Alas!
The Zhēnrén is being exceptionally foolish here.
Having studied the texts of my book,
are many parts still stubbornly misunderstood?"
"I, your humble student, am ignorant and dim-witted;
my blindness is long-standing and heavy,
and it is difficult to open my mind in a single morning."
"Indeed,
you are also being very humble.
Well then,
listen clearly again;
I shall speak for you the meaning of how utmost sincerity moves Heaven and Earth."
"Yes, yes. I await your command."
"Indeed,
as for utmost sincerity,
though it is named 'utmost sincerity,'
it means that one looks up at Heaven and acts,
modeling what is possible after the Tiāndào;
looks down at Earth and acts,
modeling one's movements after the Dé of Earth.
Thinking that Heaven and Earth caused my parents to give birth to and raise me,
they do not wish me to delight in doing evil;
so one reflects upon this in the heart and then acts.
The heart
is the most honored of the spirits within the viscera.
The heart
is divine, holy, and pure Yáng,
belonging to the element of Fire.
Fire
moves and travels upward,
sharing the same light as Heaven.
Therefore the Sun
is the King of Fire,
serving as the rectitude of Heaven,
leaving nothing unilluminated.
Therefore, when a person practices utmost sincerity,
the heart feels an immediate and sharp response.
The spirit of the heart is supremely holy;
it reports upward to the Sun,
and the Sun reports upward to Heaven.
Thus, sincerity within the five internal organs
moves the divine spirits.
Therefore, can one not be cautious?"
The Zhēnrén said:
"How fearsome!
How fearsome!
I, your humble student, have asked too much,
and this is terrifying indeed."
"If you know fear,
it is the root of life;
if you do not know fear,
it is the gate of death;
safety and peril lie within your own person,
not anywhere else."
"Even though I am terrified every time I ask the Tiānshī,
asking leads to the secret and to great understanding;
if I do not ask, I would have no way to know."
"Indeed,
your words are correct.
If one is in darkness and does not like to ask,
when would they ever find clarity again?
Proceed and speak,
what is it you wish to ask?"
"I have now respectfully heard about utmost sincerity moving Heaven;
now I wish to hear the meaning of moving Earth."
"Excellent!
Your words become deeper and more profound every day;
I shall not withhold it.
Come,
sit peacefully,
I shall speak of it for you.
If I did not speak, I fear I would be failing you.
It is as if Heaven alone detests the lack of sincerity in later generations,
and has caused the Zhēnrén to come and lead this inquiry."
"Understood.
Now I shall explain it to you.
Listen clearly."
"Yes, yes."
"Well then,
when a person has utmost sincerity
and has something to contemplate,
the heart feels sharp pain for it,
so one pours out their heart and soul and does not eat.
The one who contemplates
is the heart,
is the intention.
When the heart and intention do not forget,
the Liver is most benevolent;
thus the eyes, acting as its master, shed tears;
this is the utmost sincerity of refined thought.
The essence and brightness of a person is
the heart.
That which thinks without ceasing is
the intent and
the spleen.
The heart is pure yáng,
and its position belongs to Tiān.
The spleen is pure yīn,
and its position belongs to Dì.
With perfect sincerity, one can focus one's thoughts;
then the heart aches and tears flow forth.
The heart causes the intent and thought to take charge of actions
and notify distant places.
Intent
is yīn.
When those of yīn have sorrows, they should report to the yáng;
therefore, they report upward to the divine spirits of Huángtiān.
The spleen
is yīn
whose home is in the earth;
therefore, it enters downward into the earth to report to the earth.
Thus Tiān and Dì are moved for its sake,
and all spirits are stirred for its sake.
If you wish to know its great effect,
I do not deceive the Zhēnrén.
The Zhēnrén simply sits peacefully in a deep, secluded room or a quiet place,
contemplating the heart and thinking of the spirits,
and the spirits all arrive of their own accord.
Is this not clear proof of the effect?
This is the truth of perfect sincerity that I tell you;
I have never spoken of things that are empty or without law.
Therefore, in seeking Dàodé,
all of a person's actions must stem from perfect sincerity;
then Tiān and Dì will respond to it,
and the divine spirits will come to inform them.
If one is not perfectly sincere,
one will not move Tiān and Dì or stir the divine spirits.
Therefore, after the time of Chéngfù,
the people of later antiquity truly have no faithfulness;
they are not perfectly sincere
and do not move Tiān and Dì.
Together they deceive Tiān and Dì,
so the divine spirits do not stop harming them."
"I wish to hear how this is made clear."
"Indeed,
there is great evidence in the sun and moon."
"Now I wish to hear it."
"Indeed,
the people of later antiquity are born of fathers and mothers,
yet they together neglect their parents
and betray their parents;
among ten thousand, there is not even one who is filial.
They receive the clearing of their ignorance from a teacher,
yet once they have gained awareness, they leave.
They neglect their teacher
and do not treat the teacher as a teacher,
instead of humbling themselves for their teacher
and undertaking hard labor.
From poverty and lowliness, they gain wealth and nobility from a ruler,
yet they instead try to teach him; those below all together daily deceive those above.
Among ten thousand, there is not even one who possesses sincerity and faithfulness;
the ignorant masses together deceive their Sāngāng.
This is called rebellion and being without faithfulness.
Their transgressions are manifest
and cannot be covered up below;
they are all seen above by the sun, moon, and the Three Luminaries.
Therefore, Tiān and Dì deeply detest and hate them,
causing them to have short lives and die early.
They do not deeply examine their own heavy sins and transgressions,
but instead repeatedly weep as they go.
They say Tiān is cruel;
what an injustice!
You have brought injustice upon yourselves;
when did Tiān ever treat you with injustice?"
"How shocking!
Wonderful, wonderful!
Your humble student has heard your command."
"Indeed,
if you maintain this
and take it as a solemn precept,
then for ten thousand generations there will be no suffering.
Now that these words are somewhat finished,
those with doubts may come again to ask about it."
"Yes, yes."
The above is a great collection of difficulties regarding Dàodé, perfect sincerity, and the warnings of Tiān, to be shown to the worthy.
"Truly, my foolishness and ignorance grow more severe day by day; I am an uncomprehending and unaccomplished Yúshēng who dares to bow again,
to ask about a matter of practice.
To speak of it will surely be an error,
yet if I do not ask, my foolish mind cannot resolve it on its own."
"Go ahead and speak of it."
"I, this Yúshēng, have privately heard that the Secret Way and Essential Virtue
are the treasures of Heaven and Earth,
and the rarest things in all under Heaven.
Therefore, they are named the Ultimate Way that is not transmitted,
as they are not what ordinary people should hear, speak of, or use.
Yet now the Tiānshī has opened wide the path of Tàipíng studies,
ordering all people to create essential texts on the Way and Virtue,
and forbidding any concealment,
stating that those who do so will face heavenly punishment,
where even the death penalty cannot expiate the crime,
and the consequences flow down to future generations.
By granting everyone the True Way and Secret Virtue,
is this not excessively grand?
It leaves no distinction between the Xiǎorén and the Jūnzǐ.
I, this Yúshēng, believe that the True Way and Secret Virtue
should not be heard, spoken, or used by the Xiǎorén."
"Hah!
By what you have just said,
you incur a liability of ten thousand deaths before Huángtiān and Hòutǔ,
which can never be removed.
Since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
later generations have become increasingly mean and envious of the Way.
The Xiǎorén cut off the treasures of Heaven and Earth,
and this is considered a loss.
Over a long accumulation, this produces Chéngfù,
causing natural disasters to never cease.
It constantly causes the space between Heaven and Earth to lack peaceful years,
with numerous calamities and bandits.
The state suffers distress because of this,
which arises precisely from this cause.
What you have just said
is exactly that.
It throws Heaven into chaos and overturns the Earth,
making governance muddled and confused,
and the people difficult to rule.
This is exactly it.
By speaking as you just did,
you have incurred a heavy grievance against Heaven.
Wrong, how wrong!
You have lost your merit."
"What do you mean?"
"Now, when the Essential Way and Good Virtue are brought forth for transformation and education,
the Xiǎorén who obtain them will uphold the Way and Virtue,
emulating each other in learning,
and not daring to do wrong.
Those among them with minor worthiness, having obtained the Good Way and Virtue,
can become upright and compliant officials.
Those among them with great worthiness
can ascend to serve as assistants to the state.
Even the lowest and most ignorant among them
will still become good people.
Heaven uses the essential True Way to bring forth life,
even down to the six kinds of livestock, birds, and beasts.
The four seasons and the five elements
are the true and essential Way of Heaven and Earth,
the divine treasures of Heaven and Earth,
and the stored Qi of Heaven and Earth.
The livestock and beasts all harbor this as their nature,
and plants obtain it before they can grow.
If Heaven did not provide this essential Way,
how could they grow?
Yet you, Zhēnrén, say
that the Xiǎorén should not hear the Essential Way,
should not speak of it,
and should not use it.
The divine protection of Heaven and Earth covers all species;
are humans not as good as livestock and plants?
You should realize yourself
that what you just said carries the crime of ten thousand deaths,
which can never be removed."
"I, this Yúshēng, have served the Master for only a short and shallow time
and do not deeply know the Tiāndào.
Having heard the Tiānshī's words,
I now realize the weight of my crime.
Above, I have failed Huángtiān,
below, I have failed Hòutǔ,
and in between, I have failed the Sovereign of Great Virtue."
"Indeed, it is right for you to withdraw and reproach yourself.
In all matters one undertakes, how can one not be cautious?
Huángtiān always watches the words of people's mouths alone.
Why is it that an echo follows a person's sound as good or bad fortune?
Thus, the response of the echo does not miss by even a fraction.
Do you alone not often observe this evidence of the sounds of Heaven and Earth?
You should be so cautious as to feel you have not done enough,
and not stubbornly speak reckless words,
for the harm they cause is heavy.
You just said that the Ultimate Way is not to be transmitted to others;
how then was it transmitted so that you know of it?
If the Ultimate Way were never to be transmitted to any species,
and the Tiāndào had no selfishness,
for whom alone should it exist?"
"I, your disciple, was most improper in my lack of caution and discipline."
"Do you wish to be like the common Xiǎorén, once again teaching each other to be envious of the Tiāndào?"
"I would not dare, I would not dare."
"You must refine and discipline yourself, Zhēnrén.
Once the anger of Heaven is released,
the crime is manifest and can no longer be removed.
The Tiāndào is abandoned and destroyed precisely because of such words;
would you again join in increasing this?
The reason emperors and kings cannot bring order to their rule and often face many disasters
is entirely because they are all like you.
What you said just now
causes the True Way to be cut off,
evil ways to arise,
and thus order cannot be achieved.
Do you understand and is your mind resolved?"
"Yes, yes."
"I have awakened.
I am ashamed for having failed the Tiānshī.
I shall always be cautious in all matters."
"Yes, yes.
Now I think that every word I say is an error,
and I wish not to speak,
yet I still do not know."
"Speak plainly."
"What things are they
that ordinary people should not hear,
should not speak of,
and should not use?"
"Indeed,
ordinary people should not hear that which is not the True Essential Way
and not the True Essential Virtue.
Therefore, teachers of the lowest ignorance
in transforming the Xiǎorén,
neglect to instruct them with the Essential Secret Way and True Virtue,
but instead use superficial, false writings and clever descriptions to show and teach ordinary people.
When those among them with great worthiness learn and master these heterodox and false clever writings,
they then join together to deceive their ruler above.
When those among them with middling worthiness master false writings,
they then become cunning officials,
flattering and deceiving their superiors above,
and craftily exploiting the cautious and good people below.
When the Xiǎorén of the lowest ignorance obtain them,
they use them to act without righteousness or principle,
deceiving their parents,
craftily tricking their neighbors,
or becoming bandits who cannot be stopped.
Worthy and unworthy officials and citizens alike engage in treachery and falsehood,
and none can restrain or put an end to the other.
Beholding such heterodoxy and lack of uprightness,
it throws the heavenly patterns into chaos above,
the earthly principles into chaos below,
injures the products of the five elements,
and opposes the nurturing of the four seasons.
They together deceive their superiors,
the state falls into muddled chaos,
and the harm caused is extreme,
beyond what can be recorded.
Yet you, Zhēnrén, conversely say that the Xiǎorén should not hear the Essential Way and Essential Virtue,
and instead should be transformed through heterodox, clever, and false matters,
causing the people of the world to be dazed and blinded,
together practicing what is false and wrong,
without realizing it themselves,
thus all together becoming devoid of the Way?
For this reason, the Zhēnrén has a crime of ten thousand deaths,
which can never be removed.
What the world should not hear,
should not speak,
and should not use,
is precisely these false writings.
Heterodoxy, cleverness, and great villainy are born exactly from this.
Therefore, when I present the law for Heaven
and create instructions for the virtuous ruler,
I do not dare to include those things.
This is why I exclusively open the gate of the Way and Virtue,
and close off the path of cunning and craftiness.
Therefore, my writings are rooted in the Way and Virtue,
rejecting the laws of false writings and clever deception,
having nothing at all to do with them.
Do you alone not find this strange?
This is what Heaven and Earth consider a sickness,
and what emperors and kings consider a harm.
I will now proceed to explain it fully for the Zhēnrén:
using the Essential Way and Virtue to transform and educate the Xiǎorén,
those of superior worthiness can use them to remain scholarly and good,
those of middling worthiness can use them to become assistant ministers of ultimate virtue for the state,
those among them of minor worthiness
will be transformed into compliant and good officials,
and those among them of the lowest ignorance
will still be cautious citizens,
not knowing how to harm or injure one another.
Therefore, from Heaven and Earth, the four seasons, the five elements, and the sun, moon, and constellations,
all together use the True Way and Essential Virtue to nourish the twelve thousand things,
down to the six kinds of livestock, manure, and grass.
All are clothed in this Secret Way and Essential Virtue and thereby obtain life and growth.
If it were as the Zhēnrén just said regarding all species,
would humans then not be as good as livestock, manure, and grass?
By what you just said,
do you realize that you have a crime of ten thousand deaths that cannot be removed?"
"I have a mortal crime,
I have a mortal crime.
Do not apologize; it is just that we did not share the same understanding.
What should be done now about these erroneous words?"
"If you wish to resolve this error,
you must always, on an elimination day, in the open wilderness where roads meet from four directions, apologize to the four quarters,"
Kowtow in five rows each,
first look up toward Heaven,
then turn downward and kowtow to the ground."
"Yes, yes.
Now that the Tiānshī is teaching this ignorant student,
why is there such urgency?"
"Indeed, the reason for this urgency
is not because of the Zhēnrén himself.
Rather, it is because the words of the Zhēnrén
have touched upon the taboos of Heaven and Earth.
Since high antiquity and the middle ages,
human education has largely envied the Zhēndào and Shàndé,
instead teaching one another to flee and hide from them,
to conceal and sever them,
and instead teaching each other devious and cunning ways,
guiding and transforming the ignorant,
causing them all to commit wrongs.
Among them, the Dàxián departed far away to avoid the world,
while only the Xiǎoxián among them became officials;
having no Zhēndào,
they brought chaos to the people.
Those of the lowest ignorance,
because they lacked the Dào,
rose up to become bandits and thieves.
Both the people and the subjects turned to wickedness;
like a swarm of mosquitoes whose hum sounds like thunder,
they together rebelled against the patterns of Heaven,
destroyed the Tiāndào,
went against the intent of the Earth,
reversed the Qi of the four seasons,
and defied the Five Elements.
This has caused billions upon billions of calamities and anomalies;
the three luminaries have lost their proper brilliance,
and emperors are deeply distressed by this.
Confusion and disorder resulted,
and governance cannot obtain peace;
this is precisely the cause.
Therefore, does the Zhēnrén know whether this sin is heavy or not?
Heaven will not remove it.
If I do not teach you,
you must repent.
Thus, the reason for being in the open wilderness
is to be on fresh and bright ground.
The reason for being at the crossroads that reach in four directions
is that the Dào governs the communication of affairs.
The reason for reaching in four directions
is that it must be entrusted to the four seasons.
They are the emissaries of Heaven's Qi,
and they shall communicate upward to Heaven on your behalf.
The four seasons
are benevolent and generate life;
they shall also absolve your transgressions before Heaven and Earth.
Those who have transgressions in the future
will all follow your example.
From now on, Heaven
will greatly loathe those who do evil;
therefore, a Jūnzǐ should always err on the side of great goodness
and should not err on the side of great evil.
Be careful, be careful!
If even you are like this,
how much more so for the ignorant common people?
They teach each other to envy the Dào
and to hide it.
What you have said is usually good.
But this single statement this morning
is called a great rebellion against Heaven and Earth;
from ancient times to the present,
it is the source of the sorrow obtained by the lords of men.
However, before reaching the level of a Zhēnrén,
how can people naturally be Jūnzǐ?
It is all a result of learning.
If one learns through the Dào,
that person will be of the Dào;
if one learns through Virtue,
that person will obtain Virtue;
if one learns through goodness,
that person will be good;
if one learns through the Supreme Dào and Shàndé,
as that person grows old and long-lived,
they will further bring great benefit to goodness.
Therefore, those who harbor the Essential Dào and Shàndé
are called the Eremite-Scholars of the Emperor;
they are the foremost among the good
and are those who can assist the Jūnzǐ in transformation.
Those who do not serve in office are people of superior scrupulousness.
As for those who learn,
if they learn through evil,
they will be evil;
if they learn through ornamented sophistry,
they will be sophisticated;
if they learn through falsehood,
they will be false;
if they learn through cunning,
they will be cunning;
among those who learn,
the Dàxián will use cunning speech,
those who study writing will use cunning sophistry,
and when small people obtain this, they become slippery subjects.
Can your heart truly find peace in teaching such things?
Thus, the Essential Dào and Bìmì Dé
are the means by which to receive Heaven's heart and follow Earth's intent;
they can bring long-term peace to the state
and make emperors joyful.
Yet people instead forbid and sever them,
not using their strength to transform others.
When people are punished by Heaven,
their sins are not removed.
Heaven uses the Supreme Dào for its conduct,
and Earth uses Supreme Virtue as its home;
together they give life to the myriad things,
hiding nothing
and possessing no selfishness.
Therefore, the sages of old modeled their conduct on Heaven and Earth,
using the Essential Dào and Virtue to diligently transform the ignorant,
making them scrupulous and good,
and making them easy to govern.
Modern times instead largely block and sever these;
thus, the ignorant together become cunning and slippery,
losing the Tiāndào
and not knowing they are in the wrong.
The blame lies in the fact that Zhēndào and Shàndé are not practiced;
thus, many people receive Heaven's punishment,
facing death without being absolved.
The ignorant lack the Dào,
do not avoid taboos,
and consequently offend Heaven and Earth together;
this is because they do not know the essentials of Dào and Virtue.
The reason I have written this book
and have been repeatedly diligent and concerned
is the fear that people's accumulated ignorance
will cause them to not believe my text upon hearing a single word;
therefore, I repeat it once more.
People have all practiced wickedness for a long time,
and some might even call my words wrong.
This would again cause the gate of Zhēndào and Bìmì Dé to be severed and not practiced,
Heaven's anger to not cease,
the Emperor to suffer long distress,
and the officials and people to have nowhere to turn.
They follow one another in cloud-like chaos
and cannot save each other.
If one truly considers my words a grievance against Heaven,
I am precisely creating this Work of the Dào to resolve it.
Everyone is covered by wicked texts,
and their ignorance has accumulated for a long time;
therefore, I constantly command the Zhēnrén to bring forth my Dào,
to entrust it to a ruler of superior Dào and Virtue,
and to show it to the assembly of worthies.
Quickly test my Dào,
and you shall know the truth of my book;
it is similar to Heaven and Earth.
If it is not used or tested,
how can one know its [...]?
Now, I guarantee that my Dào is not in error,
so I seek testing for more than a single scroll of text.
Zhēnrén, be careful!"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
always heed my words
and do not lightheartedly speak recklessly yourself."
"Yes.
I shall bring them forth without hiding or concealing them,
so that common people in their speech and learning
shall know what is right and wrong
and no longer act recklessly."
"Yes, yes."
To the right is the explanation of what humans should not usually hear, what they should not speak, and what they should not use; the text for severing the false and bringing forth the true.
"Now I, a humble student, raise a matter
that does not hit the mark of the Tiānshī's heart;
I am often heavily rebuked for my faults,
and not daring to ask further,
the year has again come to an end,
yet I still have no way of knowing it.
I wish to ask for one more word."
"Speak of it plainly,"
"what is there to be humble about?
To ask when one does not know
is the proper way."
"Now, using the primary supreme Dao and essential virtue to teach ordinary people,
is this not great knowledge?"
"How excellent are your words!
What 'great knowledge' could there be?
Why do you doubt this?"
"I have heard that if a son's wisdom exceeds his father's,
or a disciple's wisdom exceeds his teacher's,
or a minister's wisdom exceeds his lord's,
then it is called 'the subordinate's worthiness and wisdom exceeding that of the superior,'
which is considered inappropriate."
"Now, what you say is correct,
yet it is also incorrect.
Nowadays, when the subordinate's wisdom exceeds the superior's,
it is indeed called improper.
If the subordinate's wisdom consists of methods of artful deception,
and their wisdom exceeds that of their superior,
then they will in turn deceive their superior.
If you wish to know its effects,
compare it to teaching;
if an artisan's disciple's wisdom exceeds that of the master,
then he will in turn harm his master.
Generally, for those who are subordinates,
if they practice and learn the ways of cunning, deception, and treachery,
then the subordinates will collectively bewilder
and deceive their superior.
Therefore, the great sages and worthies of antiquity did not dare to recklessly impart teachings of cunning, deception, and superficial rhetoric;
they always thought deeply on the root and cut off the branches,
not allowing foolish people to know them.
Thus, to govern a state with cunning wisdom
is to be a great thief of the state.

This evidence-based text

Yin and Yang will flow smoothly,

I do not praise myself.
Truly know this,

go now.

"I wish to ask the Tiānshī about one more matter before I stop."

My text □ □,
and in ten thousand times ten thousand, it does not fail once.

Think on this yourself;
if you love the high, then go high;

Therefore, I have created laws and standards for the virtuous lord of Tàipíng,
not limited to a single person.
When the Qì of Tàipíng arrives,
if there is even one person with a grievance who does not obtain their desire,

Those who desire the joy of living at home, managing their livelihoods, and raising wealth,

"Go and again strictly caution the Zhēnrén with a word,

when Earth acts,

"Yes, yes."
"Now, if Heaven is about to act evilly,

the roots are not firm and diseases arise,
that year yields no results,
and many people are harmed by distress and poverty.
A ruler of decline and evil will be ill-fated;

violating the heavenly prohibitions,
and losing the heavenly standards.
He repeatedly finds fault and blames them,
not considering that it is beyond their strength,
beyond human capability.

That which people cannot reach,
is precisely this.

then it is called distressing the people and endangering the state;
it is called chaotic governance and failed administration.
Now, Tiāndì are supremely spiritual and enlightened,

Does the Zhēnrén now understand and see clearly?"
"Yes, yes.

"Go.

how could there be an end?

Now that I have told you,

"Indeed, I receive this grace with great joy

"Yes, yes.

"Now that you know the meaning,

Go, the words are nearly finished,
the matter is complete.
If you have doubts on another day,
then come back."
"Yes, yes."

Diagrams of the Shénrén and Zhēnrén of high antiquity cautioning later students against doing evil:

“I originally studied from a young age without stopping,
my spirit was focused on it,
and tears were always about to fall.
Having done this for a long time,
I received the great grace of Huáng Tiān,
and today I am fortunate to meet the Tiān Shī in the wilderness.
When I first began learning, I was as if deficient,
inquiring about minor matters and outward ostentation.
Originally, I sought the methods of Shǒu Yī and nourishing nature, totaling three hundred sections;
then I saw the Tiān Shī speak without limit,
so I venture to ask if the body can attain long life?
Had I not seen the Tiān Shī speak without limit,
I would have ventured to ask about minor political matters.
Seeing the Master speak without limit,
I venture to ask in detail about the time since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
how emperors and kings have successively inherited the burden of sorrow and suffering,
and how natural disasters and strange anomalies have never ceased;

“Release it in the year of Yǐsì,

who shall go and transmit it.

this is the head of all the Jiǎ of Heaven, the highest decade,

When submitting it, what characters should be used?
As for the words accumulated in its textual teachings,
you alone should deeply understand them;

Transmit it to those capable of delivering it,
and together distinguish and explain it.
By the time Xuán Jiǎ arrives,
let them be eager and anxious;
if there are those who seek my book,
give them Shǒu Yī and outward ostentation first.”
“It has already been entrusted to the traveling messengers and Fāng Shì,
to be delivered to the ruler of Utmost Virtue.

“Those who obtain it and practice it with caution
are the right people;
those who do not know how to practice it
are not the right people.
Zhēn Rén, do not release it prematurely.
Moreover, the majesty of Heaven is wrathful;
it may instead kill people.
My warnings are all exhausted here.
The reason for □□,
is truly fearing the words of Heaven.”
“Now the Tiān Shī instructs and commands this lowly and ignorant disciple;
my heart is sincere,
as if it might be understood,
and I dare not be unfaithful.
I truly ask about those who draw the diagrams:
how should the garments of the gods be painted?”
“All should follow the laws of Heaven;
do not follow worldly customs.
Nowadays, people do not understand the laws of Heaven;
whether they draw figures large or small,
they make garments according to their own whims.
Garments
should follow the colors of the Wǔ Xíng.
Now, let the mother contain the child,
residing within,
with colors following each other in sequence.
Garments of ‘great layering’ have five layers,
garments of ‘middle layering’ have four layers,
garments of ‘small layering’ have three layers,
garments of ‘slight layering’ symbolize Yīn and Yáng,
they have two layers.
Garments of ‘great assembly’ have six layers of mixed colors.”
“I wish to hear what ‘great layering’ symbolizes.”
“It symbolizes the Qì of the Wǔ Xíng merging together.
What does the four-layering symbolize?
It symbolizes the four seasons rotating and generating each other.
What does the three-layering symbolize?
It symbolizes the harmony of father, mother, and child in the union of Yīn and Yáng.
What does the two-layering symbolize?
It symbolizes the reaching of the ‘King’ and ‘Minister’ Qì toward each other.
What does the six-layering symbolize?
It symbolizes the mixture of colors from the six directions.
Therefore, the world has mixed colors.
This is what is meant.”
“Excellent, excellent!”
“Go forth now;
be careful with the diagrams and secret texts.”
“Yes, yes.
Now your disciple is extremely ignorant and lowly,
having received grace to use the Tiān Shī’s texts for a long time;
every matter has resonated and is complete.
I wish to ask about one more doubt.”
“Speak plainly, what is it?”
“I see that since the opening of Heaven and Earth,

accumulating more and more,
emerging from the Hé and Luò.
Why does this book not need to emerge from the Hé and Luò?”
“Excellent, excellent!
Your question is a difficult one.
Heaven has caused you to speak;
it can be said you have grasped the intent.
Now Heaven has commanded me to set forth in detail the accounts of the inherited burden for emperors, kings, and the common people;
as the texts have accumulated in great numbers,
they cannot be brought forth through the Hé and Luò.
As for the Hé and Luò texts,
when the texts are numerous, they should be seen;
but when their bamboo slips are numerous,
it is difficult to know them all through slips.

Heaven deeply knows me and speaks through me,
knowing that you would ask difficult questions in detail,
so instead it causes you and me to transmit these essential words together.
You also know your own studies,
yet if you do not attain the heart of the Dào,

“I am currently foolish, obscure, and ignorant of myself.”
The above is the inquiry regarding the concealment and release of the texts on diagrams and garments.
"You came to learn and ask questions because of Tiān,

"I wish to hear the meaning of the secret keys.

My book follows the teachings and commands of Tiān;
it is as clear as cinnabar and azure.
If you think it is not so,
and you privately hide and cut off my writings,

"Yes, yes.

"My foolishness was not fully opened;

"Indeed,

"I dare not, I dare not.
